title: Copyright: Characters and Adaptation
affiliations: Case Western Reserve University School of Law

detail.title: Copyright: Characters and Adaptation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Elgar Concise Encyclopedia of Law and Literature (Simon Stern and Robert Spoo, eds., 2025)

detail.abstract: The law of copyright in literary characters typically arises when an author creates a new work that decontextualizes or recontextualizes a previously-existing literary character.  This chapter describes how copyright law is applied to literary characters, as distinct from copyright in the text that creates and surrounds those characters.  It considers how U.S. copyright cases approach the meaning of the term “character,” and explores tensions between legal and narratological conceptions of characters as literary devices.  Finally, it discusses the use of characters as intertextual contributors of meaning in adapted works, and addresses some of the pitfalls of current character copyright law in the adaptation setting.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了文学角色的版权法问题，特别是当作者创作新作品对现有文学角色进行去语境化或再语境化时的法律适用。文章分析了美国版权案例中"角色"的定义，探讨了法律与叙事学对角色概念的不同理解，并讨论了改编作品中角色作为互文意义贡献者的作用，指出了当前角色版权法在改编情境中的一些缺陷。
AI.research_question: 文学角色的版权法如何适用于改编作品中对现有角色的去语境化或再语境化使用？
AI.motivation: 随着文学改编作品的增多，作者经常对现有文学角色进行重新诠释或重新定位，这引发了关于角色版权保护范围的复杂法律问题。需要明确角色版权与文本版权的区别，以及法律如何平衡创作者权利与改编创作自由。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 美国版权法理论；2. 叙事学理论（角色作为文学装置）；3. 互文性理论；4. 角色版权保护标准（如"角色即故事"测试）
AI.method: 法律案例分析法和理论分析法，通过分析美国版权案例来探讨角色版权法的适用，并对比法律与叙事学对角色概念的不同理解。
AI.findings: 1. 角色版权与文本版权存在区别；2. 法律对"角色"的定义与叙事学概念存在张力；3. 角色在改编作品中作为互文意义贡献者具有重要作用；4. 当前角色版权法在改编情境中存在缺陷和不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清了角色版权与文本版权的理论区别；2. 揭示了法律与叙事学在角色概念上的理论张力；3. 提出了角色作为互文意义贡献者的理论框架；4. 为角色版权法的理论完善提供了分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为作者和改编者提供了角色版权使用的实践指导；2. 指出了当前角色版权法在改编情境中的实际缺陷；3. 为法律实践者提供了角色版权案例分析框架；4. 有助于平衡创作者权利与改编创作自由。

title: A Real-Time Framework for Forecasting Metal Prices
affiliations: University of Milan, University of Milan and University of Milan

detail.title: A Real-Time Framework for Forecasting Metal Prices
detail.abstract: This paper develops a real-time forecasting framework for monthly real prices of four key industrial metals-aluminum, copper, nickel, and zinc-whose demand is rising due to their widespread use in manufacturing and low-carbon technologies. To replicate the information set available to forecasters in real time, we construct a new dataset combining daily financial variables with first-release macroeconomic indicators and use nowcasting techniques to address publication lags. Within this real-time environment, we evaluate the predictive accuracy of a broad set of univariate, multivariate, and factor-augmented models, comparing their performance with two industry benchmarks: survey expectations and futures-spot spread models. Results show that although short-run metal price movements remain difficult to predict, medium-term horizons display substantial forecastability. Indicators of manufacturing activity tied to primary metals such as new orders and capacity utilization-significantly improve forecasting accuracy for aluminum and copper, with more moderate gains for zinc and limited improvements for nickel. Futures and survey forecasts generally underperform the real-time econometric models. These findings highlight the value of incorporating timely macroeconomic information into forecasting frameworks for industrial metal markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了四种关键工业金属（铝、铜、镍、锌）月度实际价格的实时预测框架，结合高频金融数据和宏观经济指标，发现制造业活动指标能显著提升铝和铜的中期预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 在实时信息环境下，哪些模型和指标能最有效地预测工业金属价格？特别是制造业活动指标是否能为金属价格预测提供增量信息？
AI.motivation: 工业金属需求因制造业和低碳技术应用而增长，但价格预测面临挑战。现有预测方法（如调查预期和期货价差模型）可能未充分利用实时宏观经济信息，需要开发更有效的实时预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实时预测理论、因子增强模型理论，以及制造业活动与金属需求之间的经济联系理论。研究检验了信息集构建、变量选择和模型比较的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建包含每日金融变量和首次发布宏观经济指标的新数据集，采用实时预测技术处理发布滞后问题。评估了单变量、多变量和因子增强模型，并与行业基准（调查预期和期货-现货价差模型）进行比较。
AI.findings: 1) 短期金属价格变动仍难以预测，但中期具有显著可预测性；2) 制造业活动指标（如新订单和产能利用率）显著提升铝和铜的预测准确性，对锌提升中等，对镍提升有限；3) 期货和调查预测通常不如实时计量经济模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了工业金属市场的实时预测理论框架；2) 验证了制造业活动指标在金属价格预测中的理论重要性；3) 为实时预测环境下的模型选择提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为市场参与者提供了更准确的金属价格预测工具；2) 识别了最具预测力的宏观经济指标；3) 展示了实时信息整合对预测性能的实际价值；4) 为投资决策和风险管理提供了实用参考。

title: Stock Market Reactions to FDA Complete Response Letter Disclosures: Evidence from Deficiency Types, Firm Characteristics, and Tail Risk
affiliations: and University of Massachusetts Amherst

detail.title: Stock Market Reactions to FDA Complete Response Letter Disclosures: Evidence from Deficiency Types, Firm Characteristics, and Tail Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available data and does not involve human subjects. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: We examine stock market reactions to FDA Complete Response Letters (CRLs), regulatory communications indicating that a drug application will not be approved in its current form. Using a novel hand-collected dataset of 222 CRL events spanning 2008 to 2025 across 104 unique pharmaceutical and biotechnology firms, we document economically and statistically significant negative abnormal returns. The average cumulative abnormal return in the [-1,+1] trading day window is -4.34% (t =-3.87, p < 0.001), representing substantial value destruction. Cross-sectional analysis reveals that pre-event stock volatility is the strongest predictor of reaction magnitude, while CRLs citing Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) deficiencies are associated with approximately 5 percentage points less negative reactions compared to other deficiency types. We extend the analysis to volatility shocks and tail risk, finding that larger firms face significantly lower crash probabilities. These findings contribute to the literature on regulatory information events and have implications for investors, pharmaceutical executives, and regulatory policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了FDA完全回应函（CRLs）对股市的影响，发现CRL事件导致显著负异常收益（-4.34%），其中事件前股票波动率是反应强度的最强预测因子，CMC缺陷相关的CRL反应相对较轻，大公司面临更低的崩盘概率。
AI.research_question: FDA完全回应函（CRLs）对制药和生物技术公司股票市场反应的影响是什么？哪些因素会影响这种反应的程度？
AI.motivation: FDA完全回应函是重要的监管信息事件，表明药物申请在当前形式下不会获得批准，但市场对这些事件的具体反应模式和影响因素尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管信息事件理论、市场效率理论和风险管理理论，研究监管沟通对资本市场的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的2008-2025年222个CRL事件数据集，涵盖104家制药和生物技术公司，采用事件研究法计算异常收益，并进行横截面分析和波动率冲击、尾部风险分析。
AI.findings: 1. CRL事件导致显著负异常收益（-4.34%）；2. 事件前股票波动率是反应强度的最强预测因子；3. CMC缺陷相关的CRL反应比其他缺陷类型轻约5个百分点；4. 大公司面临显著更低的崩盘概率。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了监管信息事件文献，提供了FDA监管沟通对资本市场影响的经验证据，深化了对监管风险定价机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供CRL事件风险评估框架，帮助制药公司高管更好地管理监管风险，为FDA政策制定者提供市场反应证据以优化监管沟通。

title: Joint Extreme Value-at-risk and Expected Shortfall Dynamics With a Single Integrated Tail Shape Parameter
affiliations: Alma Mater Studiorum University of Bologna, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research and Sveriges Riksbank - Research Division

detail.title: Joint Extreme Value-at-risk and Expected Shortfall Dynamics With a Single Integrated Tail Shape Parameter
detail.abstract: We propose a robust semi-parametric framework for persistent time-varying extreme tail behavior, including extreme Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES). The framework builds on Extreme Value Theory and uses a conditional version of the Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) for peaks-over-threshold (POT) dynamics. Unlike earlier approaches, our model (i) has unit root-like, i.e., integrated autoregressive dynamics for the GPD tail shape, and (ii) re-scales POTs by their thresholds to obtain a more parsimonious model with only one time-varying parameter to describe the entire tail. We establish parameter regions for stationarity, ergodicity, and invertibility for the integrated time-varying parameter model and its filter, and formulate conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator. Using two cryptocurrency exchange rates, we illustrate how the simple single-parameter model is competitive in capturing the dynamics of VaR and ES, particularly in the extreme tail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个稳健的半参数框架，用于建模持久时变的极端尾部行为，包括极端风险价值(VaR)和预期短缺(ES)。该框架基于极值理论，使用条件广义帕累托分布(GPD)来描述超过阈值的动态。与先前方法不同，该模型具有类似单位根的自回归动态，并通过重新缩放阈值来获得更简约的单参数模型。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个稳健的半参数框架来建模持久时变的极端尾部行为，特别是极端风险价值(VaR)和预期短缺(ES)的动态变化？
AI.motivation: 金融市场中的极端风险建模对于风险管理至关重要，传统方法在处理时变尾部行为方面存在局限，特别是在加密货币等波动性高的资产中，需要更灵活且稳健的极端风险度量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论(Extreme Value Theory)，条件广义帕累托分布(Generalized Pareto Distribution)，峰值超过阈值(peaks-over-threshold)方法，单位根自回归动态，时间变化参数模型。
AI.method: 提出基于条件GPD的半参数框架，采用类似单位根的自回归动态建模GPD尾部形状，通过重新缩放阈值获得单参数时间变化模型，建立参数平稳性、遍历性和可逆性条件，推导最大似然估计的一致性和渐近正态性，使用两种加密货币汇率数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 单参数模型在捕捉VaR和ES动态方面具有竞争力，特别是在极端尾部区域；模型参数区域确保了平稳性、遍历性和可逆性；最大似然估计具有良好的统计性质；加密货币数据验证了模型的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了具有单位根动态的时变尾部形状模型；建立了更简约的单参数框架；推导了模型平稳性和估计量的理论性质；扩展了极值理论在时变风险度量中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了更稳健的极端风险度量工具；特别适用于加密货币等高波动性资产的风险管理；简化了模型参数估计过程；提高了极端尾部风险预测的准确性。

title: Highly Disaggregated Land Unavailability
affiliations: The University of North Carolina at Charlotte and York University

detail.title: Highly Disaggregated Land Unavailability
detail.abstract: Standard empirical proxies contradict the canonical prediction that supply constraints amplify house price cycles. We resolve this puzzle by constructing the Land Unavailability--Machine Learning (LU-ML) Indices using high-resolution satellite imagery. Unlike existing measures, our indices capture the nonlinear and heterogeneous impacts of physical geography. We document two main facts: (1) physical constraints are a key determinant of cross-sectional price dynamics, driven largely by the intensive margin (steep slopes); and (2) looser supply constraints significantly mitigate the price effects of demand growth, overturning the "null result" in recent literature.

AI.tldr: 使用卫星影像构建土地不可用性机器学习指数，发现物理地理约束对房价周期有显著非线性影响，推翻了现有文献的"零结果"结论
AI.research_question: 物理地理约束如何影响房价周期？为什么现有经验代理变量与经典理论预测相矛盾？
AI.motivation: 传统实证代理变量与经典理论预测（供给约束会放大房价周期）相矛盾，需要新的测量方法来捕捉物理地理约束的非线性和异质性影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典房价周期理论预测供给约束会放大价格波动，但现有实证研究未能验证这一预测
AI.method: 使用高分辨率卫星影像构建土地不可用性-机器学习指数（LU-ML Indices），捕捉物理地理的非线性和异质性影响
AI.findings: 1) 物理约束是截面价格动态的关键决定因素，主要由陡峭坡度驱动；2) 较宽松的供给约束显著缓解需求增长对价格的影响，推翻了近期文献的"零结果"
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了经典理论与实证证据之间的矛盾，证明了物理地理约束对房价周期的非线性影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的供给约束测量工具，有助于理解房地产市场波动和制定更有效的住房政策

title: On Whether Sex Is Binary
affiliations: University of Oxford, The University of Sydney and University of Copenhagen - Centre for Advanced Studies in Bioscience Innovation Law (CeBIL)

detail.title: On Whether Sex Is Binary

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Debates about whether sex is binary often proceed at cross-purposes because the term "sex" is used within different discourses to refer to different phenomena. The term "binary" is also used in contradictory ways. So, people end up talking past each other. In this commentary, we distinguish between sex understood as an abstract evolutionary model based on idealized body plans oriented toward the production of gametes, and sex as a way of classifying actual human persons with diverse bodily features for medical, social, or legal purposes. We also distinguish between two different senses of "binary"-one that implies the existence of two mutually exclusive and exhaustive categories admitting of no exceptions, and one that implies the existence of two prototypical categories with overlapping features and fuzzy boundaries. We argue that while sex (in the first sense) is binary (in the first sense), there are other legitimate uses of each term that may be more appropriate-or even, in some cases, more scientifically accurate-given different descriptive, explanatory, or classificatory aims. We introduce a "Toy Factory" analogy to illustrate these points.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了"性别"的两种含义：作为基于理想化身体结构的抽象进化模型，以及作为对具有多样化身体特征的人类进行分类的方式。同时区分了"二元"的两种含义：完全互斥且无例外的两个类别，以及具有重叠特征和模糊边界的两个原型类别。作者认为在第一种意义上性别是二元的，但在其他语境下可能有更合适的用法。
AI.research_question: 性别是否真的是二元的？如何理解"性别"和"二元"这两个术语在不同语境下的不同含义？
AI.motivation: 关于性别是否二元的辩论常常因为术语使用不一致而陷入各说各话的困境。作者希望通过澄清术语含义来促进更有建设性的讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念分析框架，区分术语的不同含义和使用语境；原型理论（prototype theory）；进化生物学中的理想化模型理论。
AI.method: 概念分析方法，通过区分术语的不同含义和使用语境来澄清辩论；使用"玩具工厂"类比来说明观点。
AI.findings: 1. "性别"有两种主要含义：作为抽象进化模型和作为实际人类分类方式；2. "二元"也有两种含义：严格互斥的类别和具有模糊边界的原型类别；3. 在第一种意义上性别是二元的，但在其他语境下可能有更合适的分类方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了概念分析框架来澄清性别二元性辩论；区分了术语的不同含义和使用语境；提出了"玩具工厂"类比来帮助理解这些区别。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助医学、社会和法律领域更准确地使用性别分类；促进关于性别多样性的更有建设性的讨论；为政策制定提供概念基础。

title: Financing Fragility: New Threats and Challenges Amid New Risks and Policy Challenges in a Fragmenting Global Order
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Financing Fragility: New Threats and Challenges Amid New Risks and Policy Challenges in a Fragmenting Global Order
detail.abstract: Fragility has become the center in the current development finance discourse as it reflects a multidimensional interaction between high exposure to shocks and limited coping capacity. In practice, this interaction produces recurrent crises, repeated cycles of violence, displacement, and institutional breakdown. Therefore, it concentrates the world's most severe development challenges in a relatively small set of contexts. Currently, approximately 2.1 billion people live in contexts classified by the OECD as experiencing high or extreme fragility, and these settings contain a disproportionate share of the world's extreme poor. Conflict is also concentrated within this group, with a significant subset experiencing active armed conflict, which helps explain why fragile settings have become the primary locus of humanitarian need and a growing share of long-run poverty. Against this backdrop, this article argues that external financing for fragile states is being reshaped by three interacting trends. First, aid budgets are tightening and becoming more volatile, which increases incentives for short-horizon, high-visibility programming and discourages long-term investments in state capacity. Second, allocation and program design are increasingly securitized, as development finance is more tightly linked to risk management objectives such as migration control and regional stability. This shift tends to privilege rapid stabilization claims even where durable progress depends on long-term institutional trajectories. Third, an instrument shift is underway. Donors and multilateral actors are expanding the use of guarantees, blended structures, and other approaches intended to mobilize private capital. Yet these instruments are difficult to deploy effectively in high-risk environments, where weak regulatory capacity and thin fiscal buffers can translate into expensive capital, contingent liabilities, and rising debt vulnerability. The article also argues that current aid effectiveness assessment approaches are inherently flawed and even counterproductive when applied to fragile contexts. Thus, aid effectiveness in fragile contexts should be assessed not by project-level outputs but by long-term system-level trajectories, especially security, fiscal resilience, and durable service provision.

AI.tldr: 本文认为脆弱国家的外部融资正在被三大趋势重塑：援助预算紧缩且波动加剧，分配与项目设计日益安全化，以及融资工具向担保和混合结构转变。同时，当前援助有效性评估方法在脆弱环境中存在缺陷，应转向关注长期系统层面的轨迹。
AI.research_question: 外部融资如何被重塑以适应脆弱国家的发展需求？当前援助有效性评估方法在脆弱环境中存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 脆弱性已成为发展金融讨论的核心，涉及高冲击暴露与有限应对能力的多维互动。全球约21亿人生活在OECD分类的高脆弱或极端脆弱环境中，这些地区集中了世界最严峻的发展挑战、极端贫困和冲突。脆弱环境已成为人道主义需求的主要场所和长期贫困的集中地。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱性理论、发展金融理论、援助有效性理论、制度能力建设理论、安全化理论
AI.method: 理论分析与政策分析，基于现有数据和趋势观察进行论证
AI.findings: 1. 援助预算紧缩且波动加剧，导致短期高可见度项目偏好，抑制长期国家能力投资；2. 分配与项目设计日益安全化，发展金融更紧密地与风险管理目标（如移民控制和区域稳定）挂钩；3. 融资工具向担保、混合结构等私人资本动员方式转变，但在高风险环境中难以有效部署
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了脆弱环境中外部融资的三大重塑趋势框架；2. 批判了当前援助有效性评估方法在脆弱环境中的适用性问题；3. 强调应从项目层面输出评估转向长期系统层面轨迹评估
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供脆弱国家融资改革的指导方向；2. 提出应关注安全、财政韧性和持久服务提供等长期系统指标；3. 警示高风险环境中新型融资工具可能带来的资本成本、或有负债和债务脆弱性风险

title: Exchange Rate and Oil Price Dynamics on Nigeria's Trade Balance: Evidence from an ADL-LSTR-ECM-MIDAS Framework
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria, Nile University of Nigeria and Nile University of Nigeria

detail.title: Exchange Rate and Oil Price Dynamics on Nigeria's Trade Balance: Evidence from an ADL-LSTR-ECM-MIDAS Framework
detail.abstract: This study examines how exchange rate movements and crude oil price shocks transmit into Nigeria's trade balance when external adjustment is nonlinear and information arrives at mixed frequencies. Using quarterly trade balance data and monthly exchange rate and oil price series from 2000M1-2025M9, we estimate a unified ADL-LSTR-ECM-MIDAS framework that allows high-frequency shocks to affect trade balance dynamics in a regime-dependent manner while preserving a long-run equilibrium structure. The results reveal strong state dependence in shortrun adjustment. Exchange rate movements exert large and immediate effects on the trade balance during deficit regimes, when foreign-exchange constraints bind, but have substantially weaker effects in surplus regimes. In contrast, crude oil price shocks dominate adjustment in surplus states and operate primarily through long-run equilibrium channels rather than short-run transmission. While nonlinear dynamics are pronounced in high-frequency adjustment, the error-correction mechanism itself is stable and symmetric across regimes, indicating that nonlinearity arises from short-run transmission rather than long-run correction. These findings imply that conventional linear or temporally aggregated models systematically mischaracterize both the magnitude and timing of external adjustment in commodity-dependent economies. From a policy perspective, the results suggest that exchange rate adjustment is most effective under external stress, whereas oilprice-driven stabilization and buffer accumulation are more relevant during surplus periods.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ADL-LSTR-ECM-MIDAS混合频率模型分析尼日利亚贸易平衡对汇率变动和原油价格冲击的非线性响应，发现调整过程具有强烈的状态依赖性：赤字时期汇率调整效果显著，盈余时期油价冲击主导长期均衡调整。
AI.research_question: 汇率变动和原油价格冲击如何以非线性方式影响尼日利亚的贸易平衡，特别是在混合频率信息和不同外部调整状态下的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 传统线性模型或时间聚合模型无法准确捕捉商品依赖型经济体中外部调整的非线性特征和混合频率效应，需要开发更精细的建模框架来理解不同经济状态下的调整动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合自回归分布滞后模型(ADL)、逻辑平滑转移回归(LSTR)、误差修正机制(ECM)和混合数据抽样(MIDAS)的统一框架，允许高频冲击以状态依赖方式影响贸易平衡动态，同时保持长期均衡结构。
AI.method: 使用2000年1月至2025年9月的季度贸易平衡数据和月度汇率、油价序列，估计ADL-LSTR-ECM-MIDAS模型，分析高频冲击在不同状态下的非线性传导机制。
AI.findings: 1. 短期调整具有强烈的状态依赖性：赤字时期汇率变动对贸易平衡影响大且即时；盈余时期影响显著减弱。2. 原油价格冲击在盈余状态下主导调整，主要通过长期均衡渠道而非短期传导。3. 非线性动态主要存在于高频调整中，误差修正机制本身稳定且对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了统一的非线性混合频率建模框架。2. 揭示了外部调整的状态依赖性和非线性特征。3. 区分了短期传导和长期均衡调整的不同机制。4. 证明了传统线性模型在商品依赖型经济体中的系统性误判。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策启示：外部压力时期汇率调整最有效，盈余时期油价驱动的稳定和缓冲积累更重要。2. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的外部调整动态理解。3. 有助于设计更有效的宏观经济稳定政策。

title: Houses for the People, Power for the Gangs
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Department of Political Science, , , University of Toronto, Toronto, Canada and Independent

detail.title: Houses for the People, Power for the Gangs
detail.abstract: Housing policies are designed to reduce housing deficits and provide secure property rights to low-income families. We argue that, in contexts where organized crime is present, large-scale social housing can unintentionally generate territories of opportunity for criminal organizations. We exploit population thresholds that determine the maximum size of a large-scale housing program in Brazil (Minha Casa, Minha Vida-MCMV), together with longitudinal homicide data for all 5,570 municipalities to estimate the causal effect of housing on lethal violence. We show that municipalities assigned more housing units experience higher homicide rates, with effects that are concentrated among populations that are more vulnerable to organized crime victimization, that grow over time, and are stronger in larger cities. Drawing on original fieldwork, we trace how criminal groups invade developments, expel residents, and use housing complexes as bases for extortion and territorial control. Our findings highlight how redistributive policies can inadvertently strengthen criminal governance.

AI.tldr: 巴西大规模社会住房项目Minha Casa, Minha Vida在犯罪组织存在的地区，意外地为犯罪组织创造了机会领地，导致凶杀率上升
AI.research_question: 大规模社会住房项目如何影响犯罪组织的活动，特别是在有组织犯罪存在的背景下？
AI.motivation: 住房政策旨在减少住房赤字并为低收入家庭提供安全的产权，但在有组织犯罪存在的背景下，这些政策可能产生意想不到的后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪地理学、机会理论、犯罪治理理论、再分配政策的意外后果
AI.method: 利用巴西Minha Casa, Minha Vida住房项目的人口阈值作为准实验设计，结合5,570个城市的纵向凶杀数据，估计住房对致命暴力的因果效应
AI.findings: 获得更多住房单位的城市凶杀率更高，效应集中在更容易成为有组织犯罪受害者的群体中，随时间增长，在大城市中更强；犯罪组织侵入住房开发项目，驱逐居民，并将住房综合体用作勒索和领土控制的基地
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了再分配政策如何无意中加强犯罪治理，为理解犯罪组织如何利用国家政策扩展其领土控制提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了警示，在设计社会住房项目时需要考虑犯罪组织的潜在利用，特别是在有组织犯罪活跃的地区

title: Trading Scarcity Credibility: An Equity Index Strategy Based on Monetary Enforcement Regimes

detail.title: Trading Scarcity Credibility: An Equity Index Strategy Based on Monetary Enforcement Regimes
detail.abstract:
Equity markets often respond very differently to similar monetary policy actions,
with tightening sometimes coinciding with rallies and accommodation at times triggering
sharp drawdowns. This paper argues that these divergent outcomes reflect
not the direction of policy itself, but the credibility of the underlying monetary
constraint. We develop a structural framework in which the stability of equity valuations
depends on the variance of scarcity enforcement—the degree of uncertainty
surrounding whether monetary and institutional constraints will be upheld over
time.
The framework implies a sharp regime distinction. When enforcement variance
is low, monetary equilibrium is determinate, discount rates are stable, and
equity prices are primarily driven by growth and cash-flow expectations. When enforcement
variance exceeds a critical threshold, the system becomes indeterminate
and belief-driven: discount rates dominate valuation dynamics, volatility is amplified,
and traditional policy signals lose effectiveness. This regime shift generates
distinct, testable implications for equity betas, volatility term structures, sector
rotation, and the asymmetric impact of policy interventions.
Building on these insights, the paper introduces a regime-based portfolio methodology
that conditions equity, volatility, and real-asset exposures on real-time estimates
of scarcity enforcement credibility. Using a calibrated numerical market
simulator, we illustrate how such a strategy can exhibit convex return characteristics—
preserving capital during periods of monetary indeterminacy and capturing
outsized gains during regime transitions—without relying on traditional factor premia.
For academics, the framework identifies monetary determinacy risk as a structural
driver of asset prices and a candidate priced macro risk factor. For portfolio
managers, it offers a systematic approach to navigating episodes in which conventional
macro indicators and central bank guidance become unreliable, shifting
the investment focus from predicting policy actions to assessing whether monetary
constraints will be believed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结构性框架，认为股市对货币政策的不同反应源于货币约束的可信度差异，而非政策方向本身。当稀缺性执行方差较低时，股市由增长预期驱动；当超过临界值时，系统变得不确定，折现率主导估值，传统政策信号失效。论文还提出基于制度的投资策略。
AI.research_question: 为什么股市对相似的货币政策行动会有截然不同的反应？这些不同结果背后的结构性驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 股市经常对相似的货币政策行动表现出非常不同的反应，紧缩有时伴随股市上涨，而宽松有时引发大幅下跌。这种矛盾现象需要结构性解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稀缺性执行方差框架：股市估值稳定性取决于稀缺性执行方差——即货币和制度约束随时间是否会被遵守的不确定性程度。该框架区分两种制度：低方差下的确定性货币均衡和高方差下的不确定、信念驱动制度。
AI.method: 开发结构性框架，使用校准的数值市场模拟器进行验证，提出基于制度的投资组合方法，实时估计稀缺性执行可信度来调整资产配置。
AI.findings: 1) 当执行方差低时，货币均衡确定，折现率稳定，股价主要由增长和现金流预期驱动；2) 当执行方差超过临界值时，系统变得不确定，折现率主导估值动态，波动性放大，传统政策信号失效；3) 这种制度转变对股票贝塔、波动率期限结构、行业轮动和政策干预的不对称影响产生可检验的预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别货币确定性风险作为资产价格的结构性驱动因素；2) 提出候选的定价宏观风险因子；3) 为货币政策与资产价格关系的矛盾现象提供结构性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供基于制度的投资组合方法，在传统宏观指标和央行指引不可靠时导航市场；2) 投资焦点从预测政策行动转向评估货币约束是否会被相信；3) 策略在货币不确定性期间保护资本，在制度转换期间获取超额收益。

title:
Democratic Resilience in the 21st Century
The Return of Presidential vs. Parliamentary Debate

detail.title:
Democratic Resilience in the 21st Century
The Return of Presidential vs. Parliamentary Debate
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between government system types and democratic stability across 100+ countries from 2000-2023. Using V-Dem democracy indicators, the analysis finds that the effect of presidential versus parliamentary systems on democratic volatility is conditional on economic development. Presidential systems exhibit lower volatility in low-income contexts where executive autonomy aids crisis response, while parliamentary systems show greater stability in high-income countries where institutional constraints and party systems are stronger. The crossover point occurs at approximately $14,000 GDP per capita (PPP). These findings advance understanding of institutional resilience and have important implications for constitutional design in democratizing states.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，总统制与议会制对民主稳定性的影响取决于经济发展水平。在低收入国家，总统制因行政自主权有助于危机应对而表现出较低的民主波动性；而在高收入国家，议会制因制度约束和政党体系更强而显示出更高的稳定性。转折点大约在人均GDP 14,000美元（PPP）处。
AI.research_question: 政府系统类型（总统制vs议会制）如何影响民主稳定性？这种影响是否受到经济发展水平的调节？
AI.motivation: 理解不同政治制度在不同经济环境下的民主稳定性表现，为民主化国家的宪法设计提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度主义理论、民主稳定性理论、经济发展与政治制度互动理论。
AI.method: 使用V-Dem民主指标，分析100多个国家2000-2023年的面板数据，考察总统制与议会制对民主波动性的影响，并检验经济发展水平的调节作用。
AI.findings: 总统制在低收入国家民主波动性较低，议会制在高收入国家民主稳定性更高。转折点为约14,000美元人均GDP（PPP）。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了对制度韧性的理解，揭示了政治制度与经济发展水平之间的交互作用对民主稳定性的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民主化国家的宪法设计提供重要启示：应根据经济发展水平选择适合的政治制度类型，低收入国家可能更适合总统制，高收入国家可能更适合议会制。

title: Physics-Based Decline Curve Analysis and Machine Learning for Temperature Forecasting in Enhanced Geothermal Systems: Utah FORGE
affiliations: University of Houston

detail.title: Physics-Based Decline Curve Analysis and Machine Learning for Temperature Forecasting in Enhanced Geothermal Systems: Utah FORGE
detail.abstract:
Reliable temperature forecasting in Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS) is essential for reservoir design and economic assessment, yet petroleum-based decline curves and many machine-learning (ML) surrogates do not enforce geothermal heat transfer. In addition, high-fidelity thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) simulation remains computationally expensive.

This study proposes a unified, physics-consistent framework that advances both decline-curve analysis (DCA) and surrogate modeling for geothermal temperature forecasts. The classical Arps decline family is generalized for geothermal use by introducing an equilibrium-temperature term motivated by Newton-type cooling, ensuring finite late-time temperature limits while reducing exactly to the conventional Arps forms when the equilibrium term is set to zero. The extended decline curves are validated against Utah FORGE downhole temperature measurements and then used to construct learning surrogates on a controlled THM dataset spanning fracture count, well spacing, fracture spacing, host-rock thermal conductivity, and circulation rate. An equation-informed neural network embeds the modified decline equations as differentiable internal computational layers to produce full 0-60 month temperature trajectories from design and operational inputs while preserving interpretable decline structure. A probabilistic Gaussian Process Regression surrogate is also developed for direct multi-horizon forecasting with calibrated uncertainty, while a direct XGBoost regression baseline provides a purely data-driven reference. Across the simulation dataset, the extended decline models reproduce temperature trajectories with near-perfect fidelity (median R² = 0.999; median RMSE = 0.071 °C), and the equation-informed network achieves typical hold-out errors of MAE = 3.06 °C and RMSE = 4.49 °C. The Gaussian Process surrogate delivers the strongest predictive accuracy across 3-60 month horizons (macro R² = 0.965; RMSE = 3.39 °C; MAE = 2.34 °C) with well-calibrated uncertainty, whereas the XGBoost baseline exhibits higher errors, underscoring the value of physical structure or probabilistic modeling for reliable geothermal temperature forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个统一的物理一致性框架，用于增强地热系统温度预测。通过将经典Arps递减曲线推广到地热应用，引入基于牛顿冷却的平衡温度项，并结合方程信息神经网络和高斯过程回归等方法，显著提高了温度预测的准确性和可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个物理一致且计算高效的框架，用于增强地热系统（EGS）的可靠温度预测？
AI.motivation: 当前石油递减曲线和许多机器学习代理模型未考虑地热传热物理机制，而高保真热-水-力学（THM）模拟计算成本高昂，需要开发既物理一致又计算高效的预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 基于牛顿冷却定律的平衡温度概念；2) 经典Arps递减曲线的推广；3) 物理信息机器学习框架；4) 概率建模方法（高斯过程回归）。
AI.method: 1) 将Arps递减曲线推广到地热应用，引入平衡温度项；2) 使用犹他FORGE井下温度测量数据进行验证；3) 在受控THM数据集上构建学习代理模型；4) 开发方程信息神经网络，将修改的递减方程作为可微分计算层；5) 开发概率高斯过程回归代理模型；6) 使用XGBoost作为纯数据驱动基准。
AI.findings: 1) 扩展递减模型能近乎完美地再现温度轨迹（中位数R²=0.999，RMSE=0.071°C）；2) 方程信息神经网络在保持测试集上MAE=3.06°C，RMSE=4.49°C；3) 高斯过程代理在3-60个月范围内预测精度最高（宏观R²=0.965，RMSE=3.39°C，MAE=2.34°C），且具有良好校准的不确定性；4) XGBoost基准表现较差，凸显物理结构或概率建模的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了将经典Arps递减曲线推广到地热应用的统一理论框架；2) 发展了物理信息机器学习在地热温度预测中的应用；3) 建立了平衡温度概念与牛顿冷却定律的理论联系；4) 提供了地热系统温度预测的物理一致性建模范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为地热储层设计和经济评估提供了可靠的温度预测工具；2) 显著降低了计算成本，相比高保真THM模拟更高效；3) 提供了具有校准不确定性的概率预测，支持决策制定；4) 开发的方法可直接应用于实际地热项目，如犹他FORGE项目。

title: AI-Driven Digital Transformation and Organizational Culture Alignment in Emerging Economies: A Review of the Literature and Future Research Directions
affiliations: Islamic Azad University

detail.title: AI-Driven Digital Transformation and Organizational Culture Alignment in Emerging Economies: A Review of the Literature and Future Research Directions
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of organizational culture in the success of digital transformation and the adoption of new technologies in organizations. The main purpose of this research is to identify the effects of organizational culture on key factors such as innovation, employee satisfaction, change management, and customer experience. Considering the importance of organizational culture in the competitiveness of organizations in the digital age, this research tries to provide a framework for strengthening organizational culture. This research has been conducted using a descriptive-analytical approach. Data have been collected from previous research reviews and qualitative analysis of the findings. Then, using comparative methods, the impact of organizational culture on different organizational domains has been evaluated. This approach has provided the possibility of a comprehensive and accurate analysis of the relationship between organizational culture and organizational success. The results showed that an organizational culture that is receptive to change and flexibility is a key factor in the success of digital transformation. Also, an organizational culture based on innovation leads to the development of new products and services and increases competitiveness. The findings showed that customer-centric culture improves customer experience and builds long-term relationships with them. One of the main challenges of changing organizational culture is employee resistance and refusal to accept new values. This research showed that senior managers play a key role in reducing these resistances and guiding cultural changes. The use of effective communication methods and employee training is one of the strategies that can facilitate cultural changes. Creating coordination between organizational culture and overall organizational strategies is also an important requirement in this process. A resilient organizational culture increases an organization's ability to manage environmental and internal changes and facilitates the adoption of new technologies. This research showed that organizations with values related to learning and innovation have a greater ability to adapt to complex situations. Reinforcing these values in organizational culture is one of the vital requirements for success in the digital age. An organizational culture based on productivity and innovation has a direct impact on the financial performance and competitiveness of the organization. The findings showed that strengthening the values related to productivity and creating an environment in which employees can work with more motivation increases the profitability and competitiveness of the organization. This indicates the importance of organizational culture in creating sustainable and successful organizations. Organizational culture is recognized as a key factor in the success of organizations in changing environmental conditions and technologies. Organizations should reinforce values such as flexibility, innovation, employee support, and customer orientation in their culture. This research emphasizes the necessity of cultural change in order to achieve success in digital transformation and competitiveness, and provides a practical framework for strengthening organizational culture.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了组织文化在数字化转型和技术采用中的关键作用，发现灵活、创新、以客户为中心的组织文化是成功的关键因素，而高层管理者的领导、有效沟通和员工培训是促进文化变革的重要策略。
AI.research_question: 组织文化如何影响数字化转型和技术采用的成功？具体来说，组织文化对创新、员工满意度、变革管理和客户体验等关键因素有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在数字时代，组织文化对组织竞争力至关重要。随着数字化转型的加速，许多组织面临文化变革的挑战。本研究旨在理解组织文化如何影响数字化转型的成功，并为加强组织文化提供框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织文化理论、变革管理理论和数字化转型理论。重点关注文化对创新、员工行为、客户关系和竞争力的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用描述性-分析方法，通过文献回顾和定性分析收集数据，使用比较方法评估组织文化对不同组织领域的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 接受变革和灵活的组织文化是数字化转型成功的关键因素
2. 创新导向的文化促进新产品服务开发和竞争力提升
3. 以客户为中心的文化改善客户体验并建立长期关系
4. 员工抵抗是文化变革的主要挑战，高层管理者在减少抵抗中起关键作用
5. 弹性文化增强组织应对环境变化和采用新技术的能力
6. 学习与创新价值观增强组织适应复杂情况的能力
7. 生产力与创新文化直接影响财务绩效和竞争力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了组织文化与数字化转型成功之间的理论联系
2. 明确了文化价值观（灵活性、创新、客户导向）对组织绩效的影响机制
3. 提出了文化变革的理论框架，强调高层领导的关键作用
4. 丰富了组织文化在数字环境下的理论内涵
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了加强组织文化的实践框架
2. 强调了有效沟通和员工培训在文化变革中的重要性
3. 建议组织协调文化与整体战略的一致性
4. 为管理者提供了促进文化变革的具体策略
5. 强调了在数字时代强化灵活性、创新、员工支持和客户导向价值观的必要性

publicationDetails.detailsText: Trade, Law and Development, Volume 17, No. 1, pp. [] (2026)

detail.abstract: The World Trade Organization’s (WTO) role in international trade governance has eroded over the past two decades, and that trend has accelerated under the second Trump Administration in the United States. The Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS Agreement) was negotiated during the Uruguay Round to provide baseline standards of intellectual property (IP) protection and enforcement, combined with legalised WTO dispute settlement. This essay explores the continuing role of the TRIPS Agreement in the post-WTO international economic order, suggesting that the fate of the WTO from a governance (including dispute settlement) standpoint, and that of the TRIPS Agreement from a norm-setting standpoint, are largely distinct. TRIPS Agreement standards have become sufficiently embedded in the national laws of WTO Members, integrated into other trade agreements and arrangements, and otherwise referenced as baseline IP standards to have achieved the status of a type of common law, in the sense of a lex mercatoria, that should persist as benchmark standards for intellectual property protection and enforcement regardless of the fate of the WTO as an institution.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了TRIPS协议在后WTO时代国际经贸秩序中的持续作用，认为TRIPS标准已内化为类似商人法的"普通法"，其作为知识产权保护基准标准的地位将独立于WTO机构的命运而持续存在。
AI.research_question: 在WTO治理作用削弱的背景下，TRIPS协议在后WTO国际经贸秩序中将继续扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: WTO在国际贸易治理中的作用在过去二十年中不断削弱，特别是在特朗普第二任期加速了这一趋势。需要探讨TRIPS协议这一重要知识产权协定在WTO机构可能衰落的背景下是否还能保持其规范作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际法理论，特别是商人法（lex mercatoria）概念，将TRIPS标准视为一种"普通法"式的基准规范，其效力独立于特定国际机构的存续。
AI.method: 采用规范性分析和比较法方法，考察TRIPS标准在WTO成员国国内法中的内化程度、在其他贸易协定中的整合情况，以及作为基准标准的普遍引用情况。
AI.findings: TRIPS标准已深度嵌入WTO成员国国内法律体系，被整合到其他贸易协定中，并被广泛引用为知识产权保护的基准标准，已获得类似商人法的"普通法"地位，其规范作用独立于WTO机构的命运。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了TRIPS标准作为"普通法"式基准规范的理论框架，挑战了国际协定效力完全依赖于其母机构的传统观念，为理解国际规范的内生性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、贸易谈判者和知识产权从业者提供了指导：即使WTO机构功能弱化，TRIPS标准仍将继续作为知识产权保护的基准，影响国内立法、双边/区域贸易协定谈判和争端解决实践。

title:
A Study of Future Difficulty with Pension Schemes to Cambodia through Transforming
Experience for the Next 20 to 30 Years
affiliations: Nantes University

detail.title:
A Study of Future Difficulty with Pension Schemes to Cambodia through Transforming
Experience for the Next 20 to 30 Years
detail.abstract:
This thesis aims to find out what will influence Cambodia's Pension Schemes development and what difficulty Cambodia may encounter on the path next 20 to 30 years through the case study of the U.K., Germany, South Korea, and Thailand. State pension schemes can be a part of primary social protection networks, which reduce poverty and vulnerability in society, especially protection for low-income groups, through social redistribution schemes or tax-based pension universal benefits for the elderly. According to special conditions of employment in Cambodia, around half proportion of employees are engaging in the informal economy, which cannot be covered by state pension schemes effectively, and the authority shall pay more attention to pension coverage, including the significant proportion of people in rural areas. Combination with the case study of the U.K., Germany, South Korea, and Thailand, this thesis finds the fiscal pressure, problem, and reforms of the U.K.'s pension reform experience, which cause severe instability in society; issues on labor force supplementary and participation on female and old-age groups from Germany; the “crowding-out” effect from South Korea’s social protection systems without effective improvement on poverty groups; and increasing pension coverage rate in rural areas to improve household and children literacy with formal education, especially for vulnerable female children from Thailand’s case. These paths are likely to happen in Cambodia.

Therefore, with PEST analysis, this thesis can sort out and distinguish into four dimensions political, economic, social, and technological factors through the latest literature collection to provide a clear understanding of the context of Cambodia's pension scheme and the disadvantage that authority may prepare in advance to provide comprehensive and efficient governance to expand the potential economy of scale with fast ICT development supported by Royal Government. Finally, the tax-funded basis of the universal pension floor will be a critical part of the whole pension scheme. With sustainability, the authority shall expand Cambodia's financial securities market to contain pension reserves with good governance and foster a pension culture in citizens. And this thesis concludes and provides the short-term and long-term recommendations through the context of analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过英国、德国、韩国和泰国的案例研究，分析影响柬埔寨养老金制度发展的因素及未来20-30年可能遇到的困难，并提出短期和长期政策建议。
AI.research_question: 什么因素会影响柬埔寨养老金制度的发展？柬埔寨在未来20-30年可能遇到哪些困难？
AI.motivation: 柬埔寨约一半劳动力从事非正规经济，无法有效纳入国家养老金体系，需要关注养老金覆盖率，特别是农村地区人口。养老金作为主要社会保障网络的一部分，能减少贫困和社会脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用PEST分析框架（政治、经济、社会、技术四个维度），结合案例比较研究方法。
AI.method: 案例研究法：分析英国、德国、韩国和泰国的养老金改革经验；文献分析法：收集最新文献资料；PEST分析框架。
AI.findings: 1. 英国：财政压力、问题和改革导致社会不稳定；2. 德国：劳动力补充问题，女性和老年群体参与度问题；3. 韩国：社会保障体系的"挤出效应"，对贫困群体改善有限；4. 泰国：提高农村养老金覆盖率能改善家庭和儿童识字率，特别是弱势女童。这些路径可能在柬埔寨发生。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 应用PEST分析框架系统分析养老金制度发展因素；2. 通过跨国比较识别养老金发展的关键挑战；3. 提出税收资助的普惠养老金基础是整体养老金体系的关键组成部分。

title: Why “The Next Crash” (Projected 2026) Could be Very Different — A Research-Style Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Why “The Next Crash” (Projected 2026) Could be Very Different — A Research-Style Analysis
detail.abstract: Global economic slowdowns in 1930, 2008, and 2020 were triggered by sharp financial shocks, demand collapses, or systemic failures. However, emerging evidence from 2020–2025 suggests that any major downturn expected around 2026 may be structurally different. This paper examines six key macroeconomic and technological shifts that distinguish the next potential crisis from earlier episodes. Using recent data from the IMF, World Bank, and IEA, the study highlights persistent low inflation, declining global crude-oil demand, and a rapid transition toward electric mobility and renewable energy. Precious-metal markets remain stable but fully valued, while equity markets show signs of sector-specific fragility—particularly in banking, legacy manufacturing, and fossil-fuel-based industries. Crypto-assets continue to exhibit high volatility, undermining their role as crisis hedges. Simultaneously, accelerated digitalization and automation since 2020 are reshaping labor markets, potentially creating long-term output gaps and structural unemployment. Together, these factors indicate that a 2026 downturn would likely be a “slow-burn structural crisis” rather than a sharp financial crash. The study concludes that traditional policy tools may be insufficient, and economic resilience will depend on structural reforms, energy-transition readiness, and technological adaptability.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为2026年可能出现的经济衰退将是"缓慢燃烧的结构性危机"，而非传统金融冲击，主要受六大宏观和技术转变驱动：低通胀持续、原油需求下降、电动交通转型加速、贵金属稳定但高估、股市行业脆弱性、加密资产波动性高，以及数字化自动化重塑劳动力市场。
AI.research_question: 2026年可能出现的经济衰退与1930年、2008年和2020年的传统经济衰退有何结构性差异？
AI.motivation: 传统经济衰退通常由金融冲击、需求崩溃或系统性失败触发，但2020-2025年的新证据表明，2026年可能出现的衰退在结构上可能完全不同，需要重新审视危机特征和政策应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性危机理论、能源转型经济学、技术变革对劳动力市场影响理论、传统衰退与新型衰退对比框架。
AI.method: 使用IMF、世界银行和国际能源署的最新数据，分析六大宏观经济和技术转变：低通胀持续性、全球原油需求趋势、电动交通和可再生能源转型、贵金属市场、股市行业脆弱性、加密资产波动性、数字化自动化对劳动力市场影响。
AI.findings: 1) 低通胀将持续存在；2) 全球原油需求正在下降；3) 电动交通和可再生能源转型加速；4) 贵金属市场稳定但已充分估值；5) 股市在银行、传统制造业和化石燃料行业存在脆弱性；6) 加密资产波动性高，无法作为危机对冲工具；7) 数字化自动化正在重塑劳动力市场，可能导致长期产出缺口和结构性失业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"缓慢燃烧的结构性危机"新概念，区别于传统金融冲击型衰退；构建了分析新型经济衰退的多维度框架；扩展了结构性危机理论在能源转型和技术变革背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示传统政策工具可能不足以应对新型危机；强调经济韧性取决于结构性改革、能源转型准备和技术适应能力；为政策制定者、企业和投资者提供应对未来结构性危机的战略指导。

title: Interdependent Integrative Financial Planning Theory: Fiber Bundles, Priority Filtering, and the Irreducible Complexity of Client-Centric Optimization

detail.title: Interdependent Integrative Financial Planning Theory: Fiber Bundles, Priority Filtering, and the Irreducible Complexity of Client-Centric Optimization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Financial planning confronts a problem of complexity: decisions across six interconnected domains must be optimized simultaneously for clients whose objectives differ fundamentally from one another and from the wealth-maximization assumptions embedded in standard economic models. IIFPT develops the foundations necessary for understanding this complexity. The space of financial states is modeled as a smooth manifold with corners and planning domains are represented as fiber bundles over this base space. This geometric structure is forced by the topological discontinuities that occur at lifecycle phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 该论文为金融规划复杂性建立了几何框架，将金融状态空间建模为带角的光滑流形，规划领域表示为该基础空间上的纤维丛，以处理生命周期阶段转换时的拓扑不连续性。
AI.research_question: 如何为金融规划的复杂性建立数学基础，以同时优化六个相互关联领域的决策，并处理客户目标与标准经济模型假设的根本差异？

AI.theoretical_framework: 几何拓扑框架：将金融状态空间建模为带角的光滑流形，规划领域表示为该基础空间上的纤维丛，以处理生命周期阶段转换时的拓扑不连续性。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：使用微分几何和拓扑学工具，构建金融状态空间的数学表示，将规划问题形式化为几何结构。
AI.findings: 建立了理解金融规划复杂性的数学基础，通过几何结构捕捉了生命周期阶段转换时的拓扑不连续性，为多领域同时优化提供了理论框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将金融规划复杂性形式化为几何拓扑问题；2. 提出了金融状态空间作为带角光滑流形的模型；3. 将规划领域建模为纤维丛结构；4. 为处理生命周期阶段转换的拓扑不连续性提供了数学基础。

title: The Time-based Capital Finance (TCF) Theory: Redefining Economic Value with the Net Life Time (TON) Metric
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Time-based Capital Finance (TCF) Theory: Redefining Economic Value with the Net Life Time (TON) Metric

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nessuna
declarations.funderStatement: Marcello Rossi, Autore, Garante etico e finanziatore

detail.abstract:
Time-based Capital Finance (TCF) proposes an epistemological revolution in modern economics by repositioning Net Life Time (TON) as the fundamental unit of economic value, dignity, and social well-being. Traditional performance metrics (GDP, Gini) are conceptually inadequate, being myopic and focused exclusively on monetary capital. TCF introduces the TimesLife (TiL) methodology, an algorithmic framework that integrates the hidden ethical costs of labor and the economic environment to measure Subtracted Temporal Capital (CTS). Through original coefficients such as the Wear-and-Tear/ Dignity Coefficient (CUD) and the Dynamic Indexation Coefficient (CID), TiL quantifies temporal indignity (TON} < 1) even in the absence of monetary poverty. The paper demonstrates that the TimesLife Inequity Index (II-TiL) is a measure of qualitative and
structural inequality superior to the Gini Coefficient. The policy implications are immediate, culminating in the proposal of the Temporal Dignity Income (RDT) as a targeted algorithmic compensation for restoring TON ≥ 1.00.

AI.tldr: TCF提出以净生命时间作为经济价值基本单位，取代传统GDP等货币指标，通过TimesLife方法量化时间尊严不平等，提出时间尊严收入政策。
AI.research_question: 如何以时间而非货币作为经济价值的基本单位来更准确地衡量社会不平等和人类尊严？
AI.motivation: 传统经济指标（GDP、基尼系数）过于关注货币资本，忽视了时间尊严和伦理成本，无法全面反映社会福祉和不平等状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间资本金融理论，以净生命时间作为价值基础，引入时间尊严概念和伦理成本考量。
AI.method: TimesLife算法框架，包含磨损/尊严系数和动态指数化系数，量化时间尊严不平等指数。
AI.findings: TimesLife不平等指数比基尼系数更能反映结构性不平等，即使在无货币贫困情况下也可能存在时间尊严不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以时间为基本价值单位的经济学新范式，建立了时间尊严的量化测量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了TimesLife不平等指数作为政策工具，提出了时间尊严收入作为补偿机制的政策建议。

title: Withholding Taxes in Developing Countries: Relief Method and Tax Sparing in Tax Treaties with OECD Members
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Withholding Taxes in Developing Countries: Relief Method and Tax Sparing in Tax Treaties with OECD Members

publicationDetails.detailsText: WU International Taxation Research Paper Series No. 2022-09
publicationDetails.journalName: WU International Taxation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of residence country’s double tax relief method and of tax sparing agreements, on the difference between developing countries’ withholding taxes under domestic law, and negotiated withholding taxes in tax treaties with OECD member states. Using a dyadic panel dataset of asymmetric double tax treaties between 2005 and 2019, this study suggests first, that the difference between developing country’s domestic and treaty negotiated WHTs on portfolio dividends is higher when the OECD member state treaty partner uses the credit method, as compared to when it uses the exemption method. Second, results suggest that the inclusion of tax sparing provisions vanishes the positive effect of the credit method at home country on the difference between domestic and negotiated WHTs on portfolio dividends, incentivizing developing countries to negotiate higher withholding taxes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了OECD成员国采用的不同双重征税减免方法（抵免法vs豁免法）以及税收饶让条款如何影响发展中国家国内预提税率与税收协定中协商税率之间的差异。
AI.research_question: 居住国的双重征税减免方法和税收饶让协定如何影响发展中国家国内预提税率与OECD成员国税收协定中协商税率之间的差异？

AI.method: 使用2005-2019年非对称双重税收协定的二元面板数据集进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 当OECD成员国采用抵免法时，发展中国家国内与协定协商的证券投资股息预提税率差异更大；2. 税收饶让条款的纳入消除了抵免法对税率差异的正面影响，激励发展中国家协商更高的预提税率。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对不同双重征税减免机制如何影响税收协定谈判动态的理解，特别是税收饶让条款在调节抵免法效应中的作用。
