title: Toward Low-Carbon Diets: Exploring the Role of Climate Perceptions and Household Mitigation in Reducing Meat’s Footprint
affiliations: Lincoln University and Lincoln University

detail.title: Toward Low-Carbon Diets: Exploring the Role of Climate Perceptions and Household Mitigation in Reducing Meat’s Footprint
detail.abstract: Reducing the meat industry’s environmental footprint is essential for a sustainable food system, yet global meat demand continues to rise. This study investigates the behavioral mechanisms linking abstract climate perceptions and routine household mitigation practices (e.g., recycling, energy efficiency) to sustainable food choices. Specifically, we examine whether routine pro-environmental behaviors act as a “spillover” mechanism or a behavioral bridge toward lower-carbon dietary changes, such as reducing meat intake or adopting plant-based substitutes. Using a nationwide climate survey of U.S. households (2024–2025), we employ an econometric framework to analyze the drivers of these shifts. The findings reveal that climate change beliefs influence diet largely through an indirect pathway, mediated by the diversity of a household’s existing mitigation actions. These routine practices serve as a crucial behavioral bridge, reducing the psychological barriers to more demanding shifts like plant-based adoption. Furthermore, we find that environmental justice values are significant drivers of high-commitment dietary choices, while specific socio-demographic factors remain persistent barriers to change. By situating food choices within the broader context of household environmental pressure, this research provides a quantified framework for understanding how to align individual consumption with ecological limits. The results offer valuable insights for policymakers and food marketers in developing integrated strategies to facilitate the transition toward a more sustainable, low-carbon food system.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了日常环保行为（如回收、节能）如何作为"行为桥梁"，促进家庭减少肉类消费等可持续饮食选择。研究发现气候变化信念主要通过家庭现有环保行为的多样性间接影响饮食选择，环境正义价值观是重要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 日常环保行为（如回收、节能）是作为"溢出效应"还是"行为桥梁"，促进家庭减少肉类消费和采用植物基替代品等可持续饮食选择？
AI.motivation: 肉类产业的环境足迹对可持续食品系统至关重要，但全球肉类需求持续增长。需要理解如何将个人消费与生态限制对齐，促进向低碳食品系统的转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为溢出理论、行为桥梁概念、心理障碍减少理论、环境正义价值观理论、家庭环境压力框架。
AI.method: 使用2024-2025年美国全国家庭气候调查数据，采用计量经济学框架分析驱动因素，研究气候变化信念、日常环保行为与可持续饮食选择之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 气候变化信念主要通过家庭现有环保行为多样性的间接路径影响饮食选择；2. 日常环保行为作为关键的行为桥梁，减少采用植物基饮食等更严格要求时的心理障碍；3. 环境正义价值观是高承诺饮食选择的重要驱动因素；4. 特定社会人口因素仍是改变的持续障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了将食品选择置于家庭环境压力更广泛背景下的量化框架；2. 阐明了日常环保行为作为行为桥梁而非简单溢出效应的机制；3. 验证了环境正义价值观在促进高承诺可持续行为中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供整合策略，促进向可持续低碳食品系统转型；2. 为食品营销者提供洞察，开发有效干预措施；3. 帮助理解如何减少心理障碍，促进更苛刻的可持续行为改变。

title: The 'green arm' of the job: An empirical study on the influence of green work on green practices

detail.title: The 'green arm' of the job: An empirical study on the influence of green work on green practices
detail.abstract: This article examines the relationship between the ecological dimensions of work and individuals’ lifestyles outside the workplace. Specifically, we investigate the existence and scope of a ‘green arm’ of the job, whereby pro-environmental practices at work may foster similar behaviours in everyday life. To analyse this potential spillover effect, we apply matching and regression techniques to data from the 2023 French Ecology and Environment Barometer. Our results show that individuals taking action in favour of the climate at work adopt more sustainable lifestyles than their counterparts in non-green jobs. In particular, green work is associated with lower levels of climate pessimism, greater participation in pro-environmental political actions (boycotts, protests), and more sustainable daily practices (waste sorting, food choices, energy savings, etc.). By framing work as a driver of ecological awareness and practices, our study broadens the perspective on green jobs, challenges uncontextualized and individualized approaches to eco-citizenship, and calls for a closer look at the central role of work and its transformations (and thus of firms) in supporting the ecological transition.

AI.tldr: 研究发现工作场所的环保实践会"溢出"到日常生活，从事绿色工作的人有更可持续的生活方式，包括更低的悲观情绪、更多环保政治行动和日常环保行为。
AI.research_question: 工作场所的环保维度与个人工作外生活方式之间是否存在关联？是否存在"绿色工作臂"现象，即工作中的环保实践会促进日常生活中的类似行为？
AI.motivation: 挑战将生态公民身份视为脱离情境和个体化的传统观点，强调工作作为生态意识和实践驱动者的重要性，关注企业和工作转型在支持生态转型中的核心作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作场所环保实践的"溢出效应"理论，绿色工作作为生态意识和行为驱动者的框架，生态公民身份的情境化理解。
AI.method: 使用匹配和回归技术分析2023年法国生态与环境晴雨表数据，比较从事绿色工作与非绿色工作个体的生活方式差异。
AI.findings: 从事绿色工作的个体比非绿色工作同行有更可持续的生活方式：气候悲观情绪更低，更多参与环保政治行动（抵制、抗议），更多可持续日常实践（垃圾分类、食物选择、节能等）。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓宽绿色工作的视角，挑战脱离情境和个体化的生态公民身份方法，强调工作和企业转型在生态转型中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计环保工作实践提供依据，支持工作场所作为生态行为培育场所的政策制定，促进工作与生活环保实践的协同效应。

title: The Work of Nations – Labor Footprints and Unequal Exchange
affiliations: University of Lausanne - Faculty of Geosciences and Environment (GSE), University of Leeds - Sustainability Research Institute and University of Leeds - School of Geography

detail.title: The Work of Nations – Labor Footprints and Unequal Exchange
detail.abstract: In the globalized economy, the benefits generated through labor performed in one country often accrue primarily to consumers elsewhere. How the burdens and benefits of labor time are allocated among nations is an important question of distributional justice with relevance to United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 8. We quantify the labor time worked and the labor consumed through goods and services for 99 countries in 2017, accounting for labor embodied in international trade. We show that workers in most poor countries work more than they consume, while the opposite is true for rich countries. Thanks to our large international dataset, we confirm the trends predicted by Unequal Exchange theory, which argues that price differences between countries lead to net transfers of resources and labor from poor countries (where prices are low) to rich countries (where prices are high). We reveal that adjusting for monetary trade imbalances and labor productivity differences has little qualitative impact on the drain of labor resources from the Global South. In general, labor flows from the periphery and semi-periphery to the core, while the relationship between the periphery and semi-periphery is more complex.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了2017年99个国家的工作时间与消费时间，发现贫困国家工作时间多于消费时间，富裕国家则相反，验证了不平等交换理论，揭示了全球南方劳动力资源向核心国家的净转移。
AI.research_question: 各国劳动力时间的工作与消费如何分配？全球化经济中劳动力负担与收益在国家间如何分配？
AI.motivation: 全球化经济中，一国劳动力产生的收益主要流向其他国家的消费者，这种劳动力时间负担与收益的分配关系到联合国可持续发展目标8的分配正义问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不平等交换理论：国家间价格差异导致资源和劳动力从价格低的贫困国家净转移到价格高的富裕国家。
AI.method: 量化分析2017年99个国家的工作时间与通过商品服务消费的劳动力时间，考虑国际贸易中的劳动力体现，使用大型国际数据集。
AI.findings: 大多数贫困国家工作时间多于消费时间，富裕国家则相反；调整货币贸易不平衡和劳动生产率差异对劳动力资源从全球南方流出的定性影响很小；劳动力从边缘和半边缘流向核心，边缘与半边缘关系更复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实证数据验证了不平等交换理论的预测趋势，为全球劳动力分配不平等提供了量化证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联合国可持续发展目标8（体面工作和经济增长）的政策制定提供实证基础，揭示了全球劳动力分配的结构性不平等。

title: A Unified Dynamic Model of Civilizational Behavior: Energy, Meaning, and Demand as Structural Drivers of Long-Term Trajectories
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Unified Dynamic Model of Civilizational Behavior: Energy, Meaning, and Demand as Structural Drivers of Long-Term Trajectories

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest. The research was conducted independently without external influence or obligations to any organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions. Ethics approval was therefore not required under standard academic guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was carried out independently without financial support from any institution, organization, or grant.

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a unified dynamic model of civilizational behavior grounded in three slow-moving structural variables: energetic capacity (E), meaning-dependent activation thresholds (M), and accumulated task demand (D). Instead of relying on historically specific mechanisms or deterministic cycles, the framework focuses on how the long-term alignment among these variables shapes macro-scale trajectories of acceleration, stability, stagnation, or systemic reconfiguration.

Energetic capacity captures the biophysical and institutional ability of a civilization to mobilize resources for coordinated action. Meaning-dependent thresholds represent the level of perceived significance required for large-scale activation, conditioning when available capacity is actually used. Task demand reflects the cumulative obligations, maintenance burdens, and structural commitments that constrain flexibility over time. The interaction of these slow variables generates a limited set of long-run regimes and characteristic transitions among them.

By formalizing these components into a single structural architecture, the paper establishes a conceptual foundation for a general theory of civilizational dynamics. It offers a scalable basis for subsequent work on formal dynamical equations, quantitative calibration, and micro-to-macro mechanisms linking individual meaning formation with large-scale social behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于三个慢变量（能量容量E、意义依赖激活阈值M、累积任务需求D）的文明行为统一动态模型，关注这些变量长期对齐如何塑造加速、稳定、停滞或系统重构的宏观轨迹。
AI.research_question: 文明行为的宏观动态轨迹如何由能量容量、意义依赖激活阈值和累积任务需求这三个慢变量的长期对齐所塑造？
AI.motivation: 现有文明动态研究多依赖历史特定机制或确定性周期，缺乏一个统一的理论框架来解释宏观尺度的加速、稳定、停滞和系统重构等长期轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三个核心慢变量：1) 能量容量E（生物物理和制度能力），2) 意义依赖激活阈值M（大规模激活所需感知意义水平），3) 累积任务需求D（约束灵活性的累积义务和维护负担）。这些变量的相互作用产生有限的长期制度和特征性转变。
AI.method: 概念建模方法，将三个慢变量形式化为单一结构架构，建立文明动态一般理论的概念基础，为后续形式动态方程、定量校准和微观到宏观机制研究提供可扩展基础。
AI.findings: 三个慢变量的长期对齐塑造了文明宏观轨迹的四种基本模式：加速、稳定、停滞和系统重构。这些变量相互作用产生有限的长期制度和特征性转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了文明动态的统一理论框架；2) 建立了基于能量容量、意义阈值和任务需求三个慢变量的概念架构；3) 为连接个体意义形成与大规模社会行为的微观到宏观机制提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为理解文明长期演变提供了分析工具；2) 为政策制定者识别系统稳定性和转型点提供参考；3) 为后续定量研究和模型校准建立了概念基础。

title: Virtual Water in Global Supply Chains: Trade Structure, Industrial Composition, and Policy Levers
affiliations: Nanjing Forestry University, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences - School of Economics and Management, University of Liverpool and Nanjing Forestry University

detail.title: Virtual Water in Global Supply Chains: Trade Structure, Industrial Composition, and Policy Levers
detail.abstract: Ecological economists and environmental managers increasingly rely on footprint and input–output tools to track how production and trade redistribute pressure on freshwater systems. We provide global evidence on how international supply chains transmit virtual water and how these flows relate to countries’ development paths and structural change. Using the Eora multiregion input–output framework, we construct a matrix of embodied-water flows for 189 countries, 2010-2021, and aggregate it to country-year net virtual water (NVW) positions consistent with national accounts. A simple open-economy mechanism links NVW to trade structure, manufacturing dependence, income and freshwater endowments, generating testable predictions: NVW outflows rise with export intensity and fall with import intensity; reliance on imported manufacturing intermediates is associated with NVW inflows; and renewable freshwater endowments may not predict net-export status when water constraints are slack. Merging the MRIO data with macro indicators, we find strong support for these predictions: exports are positively associated with NVW outflows, imports with inflows, higher manufacturing shares and income with larger NVW inflows, and freshwater endowments lose explanatory power once trade and industrial structure are controlled for. In growth regressions, NVW positions are essentially unrelated to short-run GDP growth, while renewable freshwater endowments are mildly pro-growth, suggesting the absence of a “water resource curse”. The results highlight actionable levers—efficiency improvements, input substitution, diversified sourcing and better disclosure—that can support expansion of water-intensive green manufacturing without systematically undermining development, and offer ecological economics a transparent framework for assessing embodied-water risks in global supply chains.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用多区域投入产出模型分析2010-2021年189个国家间的虚拟水流动，发现贸易结构、制造业依赖和收入水平是影响国家净虚拟水位置的关键因素，而淡水资源禀赋在控制贸易和产业结构后失去解释力。研究为评估全球供应链中的水资源风险提供了透明框架。
AI.research_question: 国际供应链如何传输虚拟水？这些流动如何与各国的发展路径和结构变化相关？
AI.motivation: 生态经济学家和环境管理者越来越依赖足迹和投入产出工具来追踪生产和贸易如何重新分配对淡水系统的压力，需要全球证据来理解虚拟水流动与经济发展模式的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开放经济机制，将净虚拟水位置与贸易结构、制造业依赖、收入和淡水资源禀赋联系起来，生成可检验的预测假设。
AI.method: 使用Eora多区域投入产出框架构建189个国家2010-2021年的体现水流动矩阵，将其聚合为国家年度净虚拟水位置，并与宏观经济指标合并进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 出口与净虚拟水流出正相关，进口与流入正相关；较高的制造业份额和收入与较大的净虚拟水流入相关；控制贸易和产业结构后，淡水资源禀赋失去解释力；净虚拟水位置与短期GDP增长基本无关，可再生淡水资源禀赋对增长有轻微促进作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为生态经济学提供了评估全球供应链中体现水风险的透明框架，揭示了贸易结构和产业结构在决定虚拟水流动中的核心作用，挑战了单纯基于水资源禀赋的分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了可操作的杠杆：效率改进、投入替代、多样化采购和更好的信息披露，这些可以支持水资源密集型绿色制造业的扩张而不系统性地破坏发展，为政策制定提供了实证依据。

title: The Total Power Theory: A Thermodynamic Model of Value and Efficiency in Socio-Economic Systems Resolving the Classical-Austrian Debate and Demonstrating Ethics as Emergent Efficiency
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Total Power Theory: A Thermodynamic Model of Value and Efficiency in Socio-Economic Systems Resolving the Classical-Austrian Debate and Demonstrating Ethics as Emergent Efficiency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study relies on theoretical modeling and computational simulation; it did not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Total Power Theory (TPT), a novel framework that models socio-economic systems through the lens of thermodynamics. The theory posits that power is not a static accumulation of resources, but a dynamic measure of a system’s thermodynamic efficiency in converting energy into sustained, desired impact. We present a formal mathematical equation for Total Power ( ) that unifies concepts from economics, sociology, and physics. This framework offers three primary contributions.

First, it resolves the century-old debate between the classical (objective) and Austrian (subjective) schools of economic value by proposing a multiplicative synthesis, where value is the product of objective quality and subjective utility. Second, it reformulates power as a flow-based efficiency ratio, explaining phenomena that traditional stockbased models cannot, such as the inherent inefficiency of tyranny and the collapse of seemingly powerful systems. Third, it demonstrates that ethical behavior emerges as a property of mathematical efficiency, suggesting that cooperation and fairness are not merely moral ideals but optimal long-term survival strategies. The theory’s validity is tested through computational simulations of three key experiments: the optimization curve of agent utility, the collapse dynamic of aggressive systems, and a competitive tournament of systemic archetypes. The results confirm the theory’s core postulates, P t with the ethically efficient archetype capturing approximately 74% of system resources in competitive simulations, while aggressive and extractive strategies collapse to near extinction. This provides a robust, quantitative foundation for analyzing and predicting the behavior of complex socio-economic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出总功率理论（TPT），这是一个通过热力学视角建模社会经济系统的新框架。该理论将权力重新定义为系统将能量转化为持续期望影响的热力学效率，而非静态资源积累。通过数学方程统一经济学、社会学和物理学概念，解决了价值理论百年争论，解释了暴政低效和系统崩溃现象，并证明伦理行为是数学效率的产物。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一框架来建模和分析社会经济系统中的权力动态，该框架能否解决古典经济学和奥地利学派之间的价值理论争议，并解释传统模型无法解释的系统现象？
AI.motivation: 传统社会经济模型存在局限性：1）古典经济学和奥地利学派在价值理论上存在百年争议；2）传统权力模型基于静态资源积累，无法解释暴政低效和系统崩溃等现象；3）缺乏将伦理行为与系统效率联系起来的定量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 总功率理论（TPT），融合热力学、经济学和社会学概念。核心观点：权力是系统将能量转化为持续期望影响的热力学效率度量。价值理论采用乘法合成：价值=客观质量×主观效用。权力重新定义为基于流动的效率比率而非静态存量。
AI.method: 计算模拟三个关键实验：1）代理效用的优化曲线；2）攻击性系统的崩溃动态；3）系统原型的竞争锦标赛。通过模拟验证理论核心假设，定量分析不同策略在竞争环境中的表现。
AI.findings: 模拟结果证实理论核心假设：1）伦理高效的原型在竞争模拟中捕获约74%的系统资源；2）攻击性和榨取性策略崩溃至接近灭绝；3）价值乘法合成有效；4）权力作为效率比率的框架能解释传统模型无法解释的现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）解决古典与奥地利学派价值理论百年争议，提出乘法合成框架；2）重新定义权力为基于流动的效率比率，解释暴政低效和系统崩溃；3）证明伦理行为是数学效率的产物，合作与公平是最优长期生存策略；4）建立统一社会经济系统分析的热力学框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为分析预测复杂社会经济系统行为提供稳健定量基础；2）帮助识别系统脆弱性和崩溃风险；3）为政策制定提供基于效率的伦理决策框架；4）为组织设计和社会治理提供优化指导原则。

title: Mortality, Temperature, and Public Adaptation Policy: Evidence from Italy
affiliations: Ifo Institute and Ca Foscari University of Venice

detail.title: Mortality, Temperature, and Public Adaptation Policy: Evidence from Italy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no known conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

keywords: and Public Adaptation Policy: Evidence from Italy Temperature

detail.abstract: In 2004, Italy introduced a national program to address heat-related health risks, combining public awareness campaigns, heatwave warning systems, and hospital protocols. Leveraging administrative mortality data and high-frequency temperature variation, we show that the program reduced heat-related mortality by more than 57% on days at or above 30°C. To identify the mechanisms, we exploit the staggered introduction of heatwave warning systems across provinces and show that treated areas experienced substantially larger reductions in heat-related mortality. We further document that information disclosure plays a key role in driving these reductions. Overall, our findings underscore the importance of public adaptation policies that rely on information provision to cost-effectively mitigate the health impacts of extreme temperatures.

AI.tldr: 意大利2004年实施的国家热浪应对计划通过公共意识宣传、预警系统和医院协议，将30°C以上高温日的热相关死亡率降低了57%以上，其中预警系统和信息披露是关键机制。
AI.research_question: 意大利的国家热浪应对计划在多大程度上降低了热相关死亡率？哪些具体机制（如预警系统、信息披露）在其中发挥了关键作用？
AI.motivation: 随着全球气候变化加剧，极端高温事件对公共健康构成严重威胁，需要评估公共适应政策的有效性，特别是那些依赖信息提供的低成本干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和行为经济学理论，研究信息披露如何影响公众的风险感知和适应行为，从而降低健康风险。
AI.method: 利用行政死亡率数据和高频温度变化，采用双重差分法，分析各省份预警系统逐步实施带来的异质性影响，识别政策效果和机制。
AI.findings: 1. 国家热浪应对计划使30°C以上高温日的热相关死亡率降低超过57%；2. 实施预警系统的地区死亡率下降幅度更大；3. 信息披露在降低死亡率中起关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息提供型公共适应政策的有效性提供了实证证据，丰富了关于信息披露如何通过改变行为来缓解气候健康风险的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了低成本、高效益的热浪应对方案设计参考，强调了预警系统和公共信息传播在气候适应政策中的核心地位。

title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Advance the Research and Development of Orphan Drugs
affiliations: Pse-Ens and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Advance the Research and Development of Orphan Drugs
detail.abstract: While artificial intelligence has successful and innovative applications in common medicine, could its application facilitate research on rare diseases? This study explores the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in orphan drug research, focusing on how AI can address three major barriers: high financial risk, development complexity, and low trialability. This paper begins with an overview of orphan drug development and AI applications, defining key concepts and providing a background on the regulatory framework of and AI's role in medical research. Next, it examines how AI can lower financial risks by streamlining drug discovery and development processes, analyzing complex data, and predicting outcomes to improve our understanding of rare diseases. This study then explores how AI can enhance clinical trials through simulations and virtual trials, compensating for the limited patient populations available for rare disease research. Finally, it discusses the broader implications of integrating AI in orphan drug development, emphasizing the potential for AI to accelerate drug discovery and improve treatment success rates, and highlights the need for ongoing innovation and regulatory support to maximize the benefits of AI-driven research in healthcare. Based on those results, we discuss the implications for traditional and AI-powered business in the drug industry.

AI.tldr: AI技术可以降低孤儿药研发的财务风险、处理开发复杂性并解决临床试验患者不足的问题，从而促进罕见病药物研究
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何应用于孤儿药研究，以解决高财务风险、开发复杂性和低可试验性三大障碍？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI在普通医学中已有成功应用，但在罕见病研究中的应用潜力尚未充分探索。孤儿药研发面临患者数量少、开发成本高、临床试验困难等独特挑战，需要创新方法来解决这些障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于孤儿药开发的监管框架和AI在医学研究中的作用理论，探讨AI如何通过数据分析和预测模型来优化药物研发流程。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，包括：1) 概述孤儿药开发和AI应用；2) 分析AI如何降低财务风险；3) 探索AI如何通过模拟和虚拟试验增强临床试验；4) 讨论AI整合的广泛影响。
AI.findings: AI可以通过以下方式促进孤儿药研究：1) 简化药物发现和开发流程，降低财务风险；2) 分析复杂数据并预测结果，提高对罕见病的理解；3) 通过模拟和虚拟试验补偿患者数量有限的限制，增强临床试验可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了AI在孤儿药研发中的理论应用框架；2) 识别了AI解决罕见病研究三大障碍的具体机制；3) 提出了AI驱动医疗研究创新的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为制药企业提供AI应用的具体策略；2) 为监管机构制定支持AI驱动研究的政策提供参考；3) 加速罕见病药物发现和提高治疗成功率；4) 促进传统制药企业与AI技术公司的合作模式。

title: A Unified Model of Platform Reinforcement: Nonlinear Dynamics and the Emergence of Digital Monopolies

detail.title: A Unified Model of Platform Reinforcement: Nonlinear Dynamics and the Emergence of Digital Monopolies

declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Digital platform markets exhibit extreme forms of concentration, winner-takes-all dynamics, and persistent path dependence. Traditional economic models often approximate these markets using linear demand structures or comparative statics, which fail to capture the inherently nonlinear feedback loops that shape platform evolution. This paper proposes a unified framework for understanding platform dynamics based on reinforcement mechanisms and discrete-time nonlinear systems. The model formalizes how network effects, learning effects, and algorithmic personalization jointly generate self-reinforcing growth, stabilizing fixed points, and emergent monopoly structures. We introduce a minimal dynamical model that captures the essential structure of platform reinforcement: user adoption increases platform utility, which in turn accelerates adoption, yielding a positive feedback cycle. Even without strategic behavior or exogenous shocks, the system produces multiple equilibria, lock-in effects, and sensitivity to early conditions. All these features are widely observed in digital markets but insufficiently formalized in existing economic theory. The framework also highlights conditions under which platforms transition between regimes of competition, coexistence, and dominance. By grounding platform economics in nonlinear dynamical systems, this paper provides a conceptual and mathematical basis for explaining why digital markets behave fundamentally differently from classical industries. The unified model offers a foundation for future empirical validation, simulation studies, and policy analysis on competition, stability, and systemic risk in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于强化机制和离散时间非线性系统的统一框架，用于理解数字平台市场的极端集中化、赢家通吃和路径依赖现象。模型形式化了网络效应、学习效应和算法个性化如何共同产生自我强化增长、稳定固定点和垄断结构。
AI.research_question: 数字平台市场为何表现出极端集中化、赢家通吃动态和持久路径依赖？如何用非线性动态系统理论形式化解释这些现象？
AI.motivation: 传统经济模型使用线性需求结构或比较静态分析，无法捕捉塑造平台演化的内在非线性反馈循环。现有理论对数字市场中观察到的多重均衡、锁定效应和早期条件敏感性等特征形式化不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强化机制和离散时间非线性系统的统一框架，整合网络效应、学习效应和算法个性化，形式化平台强化结构：用户采用增加平台效用，进而加速采用，形成正反馈循环。
AI.method: 提出最小动态模型，捕捉平台强化的基本结构。使用非线性动态系统理论分析平台演化，即使没有战略行为或外生冲击，系统也能产生多重均衡、锁定效应和对早期条件的敏感性。
AI.findings: 模型显示数字平台市场自然产生多重均衡、锁定效应和路径依赖。系统在竞争、共存和主导制度之间转换。数字市场行为与古典产业根本不同，源于内在非线性反馈机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平台经济学建立在非线性动态系统基础上，为解释数字市场行为提供概念和数学基础。形式化了传统经济模型未能捕捉的平台演化内在非线性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来实证验证、模拟研究和政策分析提供基础框架，涉及数字经济的竞争、稳定性和系统性风险。帮助理解平台在竞争、共存和主导制度之间的转换条件。

title: Exploring the factors for evaluating the n-minute city concept: A scoping review
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: Exploring the factors for evaluating the n-minute city concept: A scoping review
detail.abstract: The concept of proximity has gained significant attention in urban planning, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic, when residents were encouraged to remain within their neighborhoods and rely on essential services such as parks, grocery stores, and healthcare facilities. In response to pressing challenges related to accessibility and quality of life, the n-minute city concept has emerged as a prominent planning paradigm. However, empirical studies operationalized the concept in markedly different ways, varying in the selection of amenities, time thresholds, transportation modes, spatial units, and analytical methods. These inconsistencies limit comparability across cities, regions, and studies, and obscure the conceptual clarity of what constitutes an n-minute city. To address this issue, this paper presents a scoping literature review of 59 peer-reviewed empirical studies to systematically examine how the n-minute city has been defined and evaluated. Specifically, we analyze three core dimensions of assessment frameworks: (1) major components, (2) time thresholds, and (3) transportation mode, understanding these elements differ by context and how they are distributed by city size and geographic region. Our review identifies two critical gaps in the literature. First, many assessments focus narrowly on amenities and points of interest while overlooking safety and neighborhood socioeconomic conditions. Second, time thresholds and transport assumptions vary widely across contexts, highlighting the need for locally grounded frameworks rather than universal standards. We conclude by emphasizing the importance of transparent reporting of amenity definitions, spatial units, and impedance parameters to improve comparability and support replication in future research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述分析了n分钟城市概念在实证研究中的操作化差异，发现评估框架在设施选择、时间阈值和交通方式等方面存在不一致，限制了跨城市研究的可比性。
AI.research_question: n分钟城市概念在实证研究中是如何被定义和评估的？不同研究在评估框架的三个核心维度（主要组成部分、时间阈值、交通方式）上存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情期间，邻近性概念在城市规划中受到重视，n分钟城市成为重要规划范式。但实证研究在操作化该概念时存在显著差异，包括设施选择、时间阈值、交通方式、空间单元和分析方法等，这些不一致限制了跨城市、跨区域研究的可比性，并模糊了n分钟城市的概念清晰度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 邻近性理论、n分钟城市规划范式、可达性评估框架
AI.method: 对59篇同行评审的实证研究进行范围界定文献综述，系统分析n分钟城市的定义和评估方式，重点关注评估框架的三个核心维度：主要组成部分、时间阈值和交通方式。
AI.findings: 1. 文献中存在两个关键空白：许多评估仅关注设施和兴趣点，忽视了安全性和社区社会经济条件；2. 时间阈值和交通假设在不同背景下差异很大，需要基于本地背景的框架而非通用标准；3. 评估框架的差异与城市规模和地理区域相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了n分钟城市概念在实证研究中的操作化差异；2. 识别了评估框架的三个核心维度及其变异模式；3. 强调了概念清晰度和可比性的重要性；4. 为建立更一致的评估框架提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议透明报告设施定义、空间单元和阻抗参数以提高可比性；2. 支持未来研究的可复制性；3. 强调需要基于本地背景的评估框架而非通用标准；4. 为城市规划实践提供更系统化的评估方法。

title: Japan's Corporate Governance Transformation: Convergence or Reconfiguration?
affiliations: University of Strasbourg, Toyo University and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Japan's Corporate Governance Transformation: Convergence or Reconfiguration?
detail.abstract: Japanese firms have historically followed a country-specific model of corporate governance. Yet, Japan has had to adapt its corporate model over the last 30 years, along with the transformation of distinctive characteristics of Japanese capitalism in the same period. We review the historical evolution of Japanese corporate governance over the last three decades with a specific emphasis on the changes in the capital structure of major companies and the efforts to correct ineffective board of directors monitoring. By doing this, we investigate to what extent specific Japanese corporate governance features may explain the nation's economic situation over this period. Thereby, we try to clarify the influences that have presided over recent corporate governance reforms in Japan despite the existence of managerial failures and corporate scandals. This paper places itself into the debate over the diversity of capitalism as it portrays the specificities, differences, and converging trends of Japanese corporate governance practices.

AI.tldr: 该论文回顾了过去30年日本公司治理的历史演变，重点关注主要企业资本结构变化和纠正无效董事会监督的努力，探讨日本特有的公司治理特征如何解释该国的经济状况，并分析在管理失败和公司丑闻背景下推动日本公司治理改革的影响因素。
AI.research_question: 日本特有的公司治理特征在多大程度上能够解释该国过去30年的经济状况？在管理失败和公司丑闻存在的背景下，哪些影响因素主导了日本近期的公司治理改革？
AI.motivation: 日本企业历史上遵循特定的国家公司治理模式，但过去30年随着日本资本主义特征的转变，日本不得不调整其公司模式。需要理解日本公司治理的演变如何影响经济表现，以及在存在管理问题和丑闻的情况下，改革如何得以推进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本主义多样性理论，比较制度分析，路径依赖理论，公司治理理论（特别是董事会监督和资本结构理论）
AI.method: 历史回顾分析，文献综述，案例研究（通过分析主要公司的资本结构变化和董事会监督改革努力）
AI.findings: 日本公司治理经历了显著演变，资本结构发生变化，董事会监督机制得到改进。这些变化部分解释了日本的经济状况，同时显示出日本公司治理在保持特色的同时也有向国际标准趋同的趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资本主义多样性理论提供了日本案例，展示了特定国家公司治理模式如何随时间演变，并分析了在路径依赖和外部压力下的改革动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本政策制定者和企业管理者提供公司治理改革的经验教训，帮助理解在保持日本特色的同时如何改进公司治理实践，为其他国家的公司治理改革提供参考。

title: The Pitch: Some Face-to-Face Minutes to Build Trust
affiliations: PSB Paris School of Business and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: The Pitch: Some Face-to-Face Minutes to Build Trust
detail.abstract: The pitch is an important part of the entrepreneur-investor relationship. To come to an agreement, entrepreneurs and investors need to trust each other. However, how does trust arise between them, and how does trust evolve during the few minutes of a pitch? With the aim to develop propositions, we build on previous studies in entrepreneurship and venture funding. Therefore, we rely on the main concepts of trust useful to analyze the interpersonal relationship during a pitch: behavioral trust and transformative trust. We discuss the place of formal documents diffused prior to the pitch and the importance of the oral presentation. We conclude by suggesting testable proposition on the evolution of trust during the pitch.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了创业路演中创业者与投资者之间信任的形成与演变过程，提出了基于行为信任和变革性信任的分析框架，并研究了路演前文件与口头陈述在信任建立中的作用。
AI.research_question: 创业路演中，创业者与投资者之间的信任是如何产生的？在短短几分钟的路演过程中，信任是如何演变的？
AI.motivation: 路演是创业者与投资者关系中的重要环节，双方需要建立信任才能达成协议。然而，目前对路演过程中信任动态演变的研究不足，特别是如何在短时间内建立信任的机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创业和风险投资领域的前期研究，采用行为信任和变革性信任作为分析路演中人际关系的核心概念框架。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，基于现有文献进行概念分析和命题发展，未涉及实证数据收集。
AI.findings: 提出了关于路演过程中信任演变的可测试命题，强调了路演前正式文件的作用和口头陈述的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了创业路演中信任动态演变的理论框架，将行为信任和变革性信任概念应用于创业融资情境，为理解短期互动中的信任建立提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了如何通过路演前文件和口头陈述有效建立投资者信任的实践指导，帮助创业者优化路演策略以提高融资成功率。

title: Being Mobile: A Call for Collaborative Innovation Practices?
affiliations: University of Strasbourg and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Being Mobile: A Call for Collaborative Innovation Practices?
detail.abstract:
Purpose-The purpose of this study is to examine mobile technology as being a key apparatus and interface for collaborative innovation, which allows organisations to develop their information ecology. 

Design/methodology/approach-The qualitative research was performed by in-depth interviews, observations and field notes. The eight main interviews are supported by an interdisciplinary narrative literature review of knowledge management and associated fields. Findings-This study validates the following propositions: mobile technology can offer users timely information, mobile technology can foster collaboration beyond physical and organisational boundaries, in general, mobile technology enables a wider amount of interactions between people. Thereby, this paper draws some implications about the knowledge management of creative (and non-creative) workers. Research limitations/implications-The collected data sheds light on how organisations and individuals positioned themselves about mobile technology co-creative practices before the COVID era. Therefore, it shall be pertinent to further investigate these findings through a quantitative approach to better ascertain path models and to strengthen the new results with another qualitative perspective, in the post-COVID era. 

Practical implications-The study highlights how mobile devices are facilitating collaborative innovation practices by improving management decisions, enabling new business and/or operating models, developing a flow of ideas inner/outer an organisation and fostering the ability to make innovation. Social implications-Mobile technology transforms the way to work (knowledge creation and/or conversion) and it changes the relations between collaborators in a working environment (beyond physical boundaries). This study deciphers how a creative and/or decision-making person can change their work schedule and/or routines based on the use of mobile devices. 

Originality/value-The added value of this transdisciplinary study is that it improves research on collaborative innovation and collective knowledge by revealing three pertinent characteristics of mobile technology: enabling quick decision; connecting with a glocal network and fostering collective creativity. It also creates a bridge between the fields of education and business.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨移动技术作为协同创新的关键工具和接口，如何帮助组织发展信息生态。通过定性研究发现移动技术能够提供及时信息、促进跨物理和组织边界的协作、增加人际互动，从而影响知识管理实践。
AI.research_question: 移动技术如何作为协同创新的关键工具和接口，帮助组织发展信息生态？
AI.motivation: 随着移动技术的普及，组织需要理解这些技术如何促进协同创新和知识管理，特别是在COVID-19疫情前的背景下，探索移动设备如何改变工作方式和协作模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识管理理论、协同创新理论、信息生态理论、跨学科视角（教育和商业领域）
AI.method: 定性研究方法：深度访谈、观察和现场记录（8个主要访谈），辅以跨学科叙事文献综述（知识管理及相关领域）
AI.findings:
1. 移动技术能够为用户提供及时信息
2. 移动技术能够促进超越物理和组织边界的协作
3. 移动技术总体上能够实现更广泛的人际互动
4. 移动设备通过改善管理决策、支持新业务/运营模式、促进组织内外创意流动、提升创新能力来促进协同创新实践
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了移动技术的三个关键特征：支持快速决策、连接全球本地网络、促进集体创造力
2. 在协同创新和集体知识研究领域做出贡献
3. 在教育与商业领域之间建立了理论桥梁
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 帮助组织理解移动技术如何改变工作方式（知识创造和转化）
2. 指导创意和决策人员如何基于移动设备使用调整工作安排和惯例
3. 为后疫情时代的移动技术协同创新实践提供实践启示

title: Managerial Control in an Online Constructivist Learning Environment: A Teacher's Perspective
affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong -Liverpool University and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Managerial Control in an Online Constructivist Learning Environment: A Teacher's Perspective
detail.abstract: This article presents the lessons learned from an online teaching experience in the field of managerial control. The study aims to identify the determinants which influence collaborative behaviors between students in management studies and more specifically during the construction of performance measures. A business simulation specifically elaborated for this study is used. The study is conducted through a particular research design consisting of an online learning environment built on constructivist learning principles. The learning environment simulates the different steps of a performance dashboard creation (a set of performance indicators) for a fictitious organization. The study adopts an exploratory sequential design to explore and examine social behaviors during the process of knowledge construction related to performance measures. It contributes to a better understanding of the role of cognitive and behavioral skills in the profession of management accounting and how teachers can incorporate such aspects into their courses. It helps to build awareness among educators about the benefits of using digital learning solutions to help students in accounting and managerial control develop their professional skills most effectively.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在线教学实验探讨管理控制课程中影响学生协作行为的因素，特别关注绩效指标构建过程中的社会行为，使用基于建构主义原则设计的商业模拟环境，为管理会计教育提供实践启示。
AI.research_question: 在管理控制课程中，哪些因素影响学生在绩效指标构建过程中的协作行为？
AI.motivation: 理解管理会计专业中认知和行为技能的作用，以及教师如何在课程中融入这些方面，帮助教育工作者认识数字学习解决方案在培养学生专业技能方面的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建构主义学习理论，强调知识是在社会互动中构建的；管理控制理论，特别是绩效测量和仪表板创建的相关理论。
AI.method: 采用探索性顺序设计，使用专门为研究开发的商业模拟环境，该环境基于建构主义学习原则构建的在线学习平台，模拟虚构组织绩效仪表板创建的不同步骤。
AI.findings: 识别了影响学生在绩效指标构建过程中协作行为的关键决定因素，揭示了认知和行为技能在管理会计专业中的重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了建构主义学习理论在管理控制教育中的应用，深化了对绩效测量知识构建过程中社会行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理会计教师提供了将认知和行为技能融入课程的具体方法，展示了数字学习解决方案在培养学生专业技能方面的实际价值，帮助教育工作者更有效地设计在线教学环境。

title: Greatest Moments In Vix
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Greatest Moments In Vix
detail.abstract: The CBOE VIX Index is widely interpreted as a measure of the expected 30-day realized volatility of the U.S. stock market. This paper argues that (1) the V, aa measure IX is not a measure of expected realized volatility, and (2) the VIX is not even of expected volatility at a 30-day horizon.ble Instead, the VIX is based on a calibrated blend of all the moments of the 30-day return of the S&P 500 Index.. Variance is a significant factor, but not the only one to determine VIX. Skewness, kurtosis and all higher moments also contribute to VIX. We estimate these contributions of these moments for the period extending from October 1997 to December 2003, and explore how they vary under different market conditions.

AI.tldr: VIX指数并非市场预期30天已实现波动率的衡量指标，也不是30天期限的预期波动率指标。VIX实际上是基于标普500指数30天收益率所有矩的校准混合，方差是重要因素但不是唯一决定因素，偏度、峰度和所有高阶矩都对VIX有贡献。
AI.research_question: VIX指数究竟衡量什么？它是否真的如广泛认为的那样衡量市场预期30天已实现波动率？
AI.motivation: VIX指数被广泛解释为美国股市预期30天已实现波动率的衡量指标，但作者认为这种解释存在根本性错误，需要重新审视VIX的真实含义和构成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于矩理论，特别是高阶矩（偏度、峰度等）在资产定价和波动率衡量中的作用。VIX不仅包含方差信息，还包含所有高阶矩的信息。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用1997年10月至2003年12月期间的数据，估计各阶矩对VIX的贡献，并探索不同市场条件下这些贡献的变化。
AI.findings: VIX不是预期已实现波动率的衡量指标，也不是30天期限的预期波动率指标。VIX是标普500指数30天收益率所有矩的校准混合，方差是重要因素但不是唯一决定因素，偏度、峰度和所有高阶矩都对VIX有显著贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了VIX作为预期已实现波动率衡量指标的传统观点，提出了VIX作为所有矩的混合的新理论框架，深化了对波动率指数本质的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和风险管理从业者提供了对VIX更准确的理解，有助于更精确地使用VIX进行市场情绪判断、风险管理和衍生品定价。

title: Are Female-dominated Cancers Underfunded?
affiliations: University of Barcelona,  and University of Barcelona

detail.title: Are Female-dominated Cancers Underfunded?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the underfunding of female-dominated cancers in Europe and explores the mechanisms underlying the unequal distribution of research grants. Using a novel ownedcollected dataset of projects granted by the European Commission, we find that male-dominated cancers receive 3.7% more funding than female-dominated cancers. Our analysis suggests that this difference is likely driven by the overrepresentation of male researchers in cancer research and the higher proportion of male members on evaluation panels, which favors funding towards male-dominated cancer projects. We find no suggestive evidence that the funding gap is driven by gender gaps in the probability of receiving grants, superior research outputs, or greater mortality. By uncovering the underfunding of female-dominated cancers, this study contributes to our understanding of the allocation of research funding across diseases and its implications for health equity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现欧洲女性主导癌症研究资金不足，男性主导癌症比女性主导癌症多获得3.7%的资金，主要原因是癌症研究领域男性研究人员过多和评审委员会男性成员比例过高
AI.research_question: 欧洲女性主导癌症研究资金不足的原因是什么？研究资金分配不均的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 揭示欧洲癌症研究资金分配中的性别不平等问题，探索导致女性主导癌症研究资金不足的机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究资金分配不平等理论、性别偏见在科学资助中的影响、健康公平理论
AI.method: 使用欧洲委员会资助项目的新数据集进行分析，比较男性主导和女性主导癌症的资金分配差异
AI.findings: 1. 男性主导癌症比女性主导癌症多获得3.7%的资金；2. 资金差异主要由癌症研究领域男性研究人员过多和评审委员会男性成员比例过高导致；3. 没有证据表明资金差距是由获得资助概率、研究成果质量或死亡率差异造成的
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了研究资金分配中的系统性性别偏见机制，为理解科学资助不平等提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善癌症研究资金分配公平性的依据，有助于促进健康公平和性别平等

title: Creativity on the Move: Nexus of Technology, Slack and Social Complexities
affiliations: University of Strasbourg and University of Strasbourg - Faculty of Economics and Management, University of Strasbourg - Bureau of Economic Theory and Application (BETA)

detail.title: Creativity on the Move: Nexus of Technology, Slack and Social Complexities
detail.abstract: While creativity is most commonly associated with idea generation and problem solving at the individual or team level, it is likewise associated with environments, technologies, tools and artefacts favouring or hindering creative capabilities. Research struggles to bring these elements together. We develop a model for the integration of mobile devices into creative processes. More specifically, we elaborate on existing works on creativity to define how firms can make good use of mobile technology in order to enhance the creativity of their employees. Therefore, we suggest a model revisiting the notion of "creative slack" (with the introduction of the notion of mobile slack, or m-slack) and absorptive capacities, explaining how firms might better integrate digital natives; subsequently, we discuss the managerial and theoretical implications.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个将移动设备整合到创意流程中的模型，通过引入"移动松弛"概念和吸收能力理论，解释企业如何利用移动技术提升员工创造力。
AI.research_question: 企业如何有效利用移动技术来增强员工的创造力？
AI.motivation: 现有研究难以将创造力（通常与个人或团队层面的创意产生和问题解决相关）与环境、技术、工具和人工制品等支持或阻碍创造力的要素整合在一起。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创意松弛理论（引入移动松弛概念）、吸收能力理论
AI.method: 概念模型开发，基于现有创造力研究进行理论构建
AI.findings: 提出了一个整合移动设备到创意流程的模型，解释了企业如何通过移动技术和吸收能力更好地整合数字原生代员工。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新审视"创意松弛"概念，引入"移动松弛"新概念；将吸收能力理论与移动技术整合；为数字原生代整合提供理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供利用移动技术增强员工创造力的管理指导；帮助企业更好地整合数字原生代员工；提供移动技术应用的具体策略。

title: Japan’s Economic Miracle, Bretton Woods, Nixon, China’s Rise, WTO Entry, and the Transformation of Global Industrial Power

detail.title: Japan’s Economic Miracle, Bretton Woods, Nixon, China’s Rise, WTO Entry, and the Transformation of Global Industrial Power

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflict of interest

detail.abstract: Japan's postwar transformation from military defeat in 1945 to becoming the world's second-largest economy by 1968 represents one of the most consequential and closely studied economic developments of the twentieth century. This paper provides a comprehensive academic analysis of Japan's ascent, situating it within a wider international political economy shaped by the Bretton Woods monetary system, Cold War geopolitics, and evolving global trade architecture. The analysis demonstrates that Japan's "Economic Miracle" was not the product of market forces alone but emerged from a synergistic interaction of institutional reconstruction, state-led industrial policy, strategic currency undervaluation, technological upgrading, and integration into a stable, rules-based international monetary system. Emphasis is placed on the pivotal role of the Bretton Woods framework. In particular, the fixed and strategically undervalued exchange rate of ¥360 per U.S. dollar created a durable competitive advantage that supported export-led industrialisation and long-term investment planning.

AI.tldr: 日本战后从1945年战败到1968年成为世界第二大经济体的转型，是20世纪最重要的经济奇迹之一。本文分析表明，日本的"经济奇迹"并非单纯市场力量的结果，而是制度重建、国家主导产业政策、战略性货币低估、技术升级以及融入稳定的国际货币体系等多因素协同作用的结果。
AI.research_question: 日本战后如何实现从战败国到世界第二大经济体的经济奇迹转型？这一转型在国际政治经济背景下受到哪些关键因素的影响？
AI.motivation: 日本战后经济奇迹是20世纪最重要的经济发展案例之一，但对其成功因素的理解需要超越单纯的市场力量解释，需要从更广阔的国际政治经济视角分析制度、政策和国际体系的多重作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际政治经济学、发展型国家理论、制度经济学、汇率政策理论、产业政策理论
AI.method: 综合学术分析，将日本经济奇迹置于布雷顿森林货币体系、冷战地缘政治和全球贸易架构的国际政治经济背景下进行历史制度分析
AI.findings: 日本经济奇迹是多重因素协同作用的结果：1）制度重建；2）国家主导的产业政策；3）战略性货币低估（特别是360日元兑1美元的固定汇率）；4）技术升级；5）融入稳定的规则为基础的国际货币体系。布雷顿森林框架特别是固定且战略性低估的汇率创造了持久的竞争优势，支持了出口导向型工业化和长期投资规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战了单纯市场力量解释经济奇迹的观点；2）强调了国际政治经济体系对国内经济发展的塑造作用；3）提出了制度、政策和国际体系协同作用的分析框架；4）深化了对发展型国家理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为发展中国家提供可借鉴的发展模式；2）强调了汇率政策在出口导向型工业化中的战略作用；3）展示了产业政策与技术升级的协同效应；4）说明了融入国际体系对经济发展的积极影响。

title: Job-Backed Securities: A Framework for Crisis Employment Stabilization

detail.title: Job-Backed Securities: A Framework for Crisis Employment Stabilization
detail.abstract: The 2008 financial crisis revealed a critical gap in macroeconomic policy: while central banks deployed massive interventions to stabilize financial markets (TARP: 700 billion USD), employment collapsed independently, with 8.7 million jobs lost and unemployment peaking at 9.6%. Traditional fiscal responses (ARRA: 831 billion USD) arrived too slowly and lacked direct employment mechanisms. This paper proposes Job-Backed Securities (JOBS), a monetary-fiscal instrument that directly ties Federal Reserve liquidity provision to employment retention, enabling rapid crisis response while maintaining institutional separation and avoiding traditional fiscal expenditure. JOBS operate through a straightforward mechanism: companies issue bonds backed by five years of worker salary in the 10,000-80,000 USD wage bracket, immediately selling them to the Federal Reserve (as monopoly buyer) for cash. If workers remain employed through the five-year term, the bond is satisfied through salary payments and the company owes nothing. If workers are terminated before maturity, the company must repay the bond within 30 days of termination through a progressive clawback schedule (100% if fired during Years 0-2, declining to 20% if fired in the final six months). The 30day repayment requirement prevents companies from gaming the system through bankruptcy delays or asset concealment. To prevent abuse, deadweight loss, and cash hoarding, JOBS incorporate three core safeguards: wage caps (targeting vulnerable workers), per-firm workforce caps (limiting issuance to a share of total employees), and sector-specific caps (allocating higher coverage to empirically more vulnerable sectors such as manufacturing, construction, hospitality, and retail). The framework addresses three distinct crises simultaneously: the liquidity crisis (immediate 500 billion USD in company cash prevents cascade bankruptcies), the employment crisis (retention contracts targeted at at-risk workers and sectors), and the normalization crisis (clawback repayments deployed flexibly as quantitative tightening or fiscal support based on inflation conditions). Unlike mortgage-backed securities, JOBS eliminate secondary market risk through Fed monopoly purchasing, prevent speculative leverage, and maintain direct employment verification mechanisms. This paper outlines the institutional design, operational mechanics, legal authority, safeguards, political economy, and policy implications of JOBS as a permanent framework for crisis employment management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"就业支持证券"(JOBS)作为新型货币-财政工具，将美联储流动性提供与就业保留直接挂钩，实现快速危机响应，同时保持机构分离并避免传统财政支出。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够在金融危机中同时解决流动性危机、就业危机和正常化危机的货币-财政工具，实现快速就业保留而不依赖传统财政支出？
AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机暴露了宏观经济政策的重大缺陷：央行大规模干预稳定金融市场，但就业独立崩溃，传统财政应对措施反应过慢且缺乏直接就业机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合货币政策和财政政策理论，提出新型货币-财政工具框架，强调机构分离原则下的危机应对机制设计。
AI.method: 提出JOBS的制度设计、操作机制、法律授权、保障措施、政治经济学和政策影响分析框架，包括工资上限、公司员工比例上限、行业特定上限等核心保障机制。
AI.findings: JOBS能够同时解决三个危机：流动性危机（立即提供5000亿美元现金防止连锁破产）、就业危机（针对风险工人和行业的保留合同）、正常化危机（根据通胀条件灵活部署追回还款作为量化紧缩或财政支持）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新型货币-财政工具理论框架，突破了传统货币政策与财政政策的分离界限，建立了直接就业保留的危机应对机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可操作的危机就业管理永久框架，包括具体操作机制、法律依据、保障措施和实施路径。

title: Artificial Intelligent Patents and Generative AI In The EU: False Myths and Real Challenges

detail.title: Artificial Intelligent Patents and Generative AI In The EU: False Myths and Real Challenges

declarations.funderStatement: The contribution stems from the research conducted within the Jean Monnet Chair in EU Innovation Law and Policy for the Digital Age, chair-holder Prof. Emanuela Arezzo, (2023-2026), co-founded by the European Commission, Project ID:101127894 - EUILAP.

detail.abstract:
For some time now the academic debate has centered on the patentability of artificial intelligence systems and products, with numerous questions concerning inventorship, patentability requirements, the requirement of sufficient disclosure of the invention and so on. Yet when it comes to artificial intelligence, patentable inventions unfold on different levels, each carrying specific features which differently affect patentability requirements. Patentable inventions may consist of a development or technical improvement related to the very functioning of an intelligent system (for example, a new machine learning technique) or one of its components. Furthermore, inventions may also regard the creation of “customized” intelligent systems designed to achieve a specific result. For example, one may think of an invention relating to a method and apparatus programmed to detect irregular heartbeats through a neural network. In this second example, the inventive concept does not lie exclusively within the domain of computer science. Rather, it materializes in the development of an “intelligent” product or system that performs a certain inferential function and generates a specific output (for instance, acquiring and processing heartbeat data in order to generate predictions about a patient’s state of health).

The scenario becomes more complex when intelligent systems are capable of producing not mere information, but also an output that is itself eligible for patent protection. Consider, for example, the phenomenon of so-called robot scientists: sophisticated laboratory automation systems that employ artificial intelligence techniques to discover new knowledge through repeated cycles of experimentation. This further type of system is distinguished by the fact that the result it produces may itself be eligible for patent protection, independently of the AI system that generated it, which is often already protected by a prior patent (as in the well-known case of Steven Thaler’s creative machine). Hence, a different category of patentable inventions emerges, i.e. the AI by-products.

It is essential to clarify from the outset, however, that an invention arising as the output of an intelligent system is not, in itself, an intelligent product. Unlike the other two types of inventions, it possesses no inferential capability and is often an entirely ordinary product, such as a protein or a fractal container for food or liquid preservation.

The patenting of each of these types of invention presents its own distinct set of issues, requiring separate reflection on the interpretation of existing patent law. This essay argues that by adopting the right perspective and correctly identifying the characteristics of the invention for which protection is sought, many of the alleged problems regarding patentability may find an answer.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨人工智能相关发明的专利性问题，区分了三种不同类型：AI系统本身的技术改进、定制化AI系统的开发、以及AI系统产生的可专利性输出（AI副产品）。论文认为通过正确识别发明特征，许多专利性问题可以得到解决。
AI.research_question: 人工智能相关发明的专利性问题如何根据不同类型进行区分和解决？
AI.motivation: 当前学术争论集中在AI系统的专利性上，涉及发明人身份、专利性要求、充分披露等问题。但AI相关发明在不同层面展开，每种类型对专利性要求的影响不同，需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利法理论框架，特别是关于发明人身份、专利性要求（新颖性、创造性、实用性）、充分披露要求等核心概念。区分三类AI相关发明：AI系统技术改进、定制化AI系统、AI系统产生的输出（AI副产品）。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念区分方法。通过类型学分析，将AI相关发明分为三类，分别探讨其专利性问题的特殊性。采用案例分析方法（如Steven Thaler的"创造性机器"案例）。
AI.findings:
1. AI相关发明可分为三类：AI系统本身的技术改进、定制化AI系统、AI系统产生的输出
2. 每类发明面临不同的专利性问题
3. AI系统产生的输出（如蛋白质、分形容器）本身不是智能产品，但可能具有专利性
4. 正确识别发明特征有助于解决专利性问题
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了AI相关发明的分类框架
2. 澄清了AI副产品与智能产品的区别
3. 为不同类型AI发明的专利性分析提供了理论工具
4. 挑战了将AI相关发明视为单一类别的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为专利审查员提供评估AI相关发明的框架
2. 帮助发明人和专利律师正确识别和保护AI相关发明
3. 为政策制定者提供区分不同类型AI发明的参考
4. 减少AI专利领域的法律不确定性

title: Algorithmic Auditing for Employee Health: Bridging the Verification Gap in GRI 403 Compliance via Topological Data Analysis

detail.title: Algorithmic Auditing for Employee Health: Bridging the Verification Gap in GRI 403 Compliance via Topological Data Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The case study data presented in this white paper was anonymized at the source. All physiological indicators were processed using the proprietary AICU "Compute-to-Code" architecture to ensure zero-knowledge data privacy and compliance with GDPR/PIPL.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was internally funded by AICU Laboratory for Physiological Topology.

detail.abstract:
From Liability to Asset: The Mathematical Verification of Human Capital Human capital is often the largest asset on a balance sheet, yet in the context of ESG, it remains a "black box" of unverifiable risk. Traditional disclosures under GRI 403—reliant on lagging accident rates and subjective surveys—are no longer sufficient. In the eyes of rigorous auditing, unverified data is not an asset; it is a liability. This paper introduces a paradigm shift: a standardized protocol based on Topological Data Analysis (TDA) and Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH). By reconstructing physiological time-series data into phase-space manifolds, we do not merely "monitor" health; we quantify Human Capital Risk as an objective, immutable digital asset.
Powered by our proprietary system (Patent Pending US 63/949,330), this protocol provides a privacy-preserving "Algorithmic Audit Trail," enabling corporations to transform workforce well-being from a qualitative story into a quantitative, auditable stock.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑数据分析(TDA)和局部敏感哈希(LSH)的标准化协议，将人力资本风险量化为客观、不可变的数字资产，实现从定性描述到可审计定量指标的转变。
AI.research_question: 如何将人力资本从ESG报告中的"黑箱"风险转变为可验证、可审计的数字资产？
AI.motivation: 传统的人力资本披露方法（如GRI 403标准依赖滞后的事故率和主观调查）已不足以满足严格审计要求，未经验证的数据在审计视角下是负债而非资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拓扑数据分析(TDA)理论、局部敏感哈希(LSH)算法、相空间流形重构理论、人力资本风险量化框架。
AI.method: 基于TDA和LSH的标准化协议，将生理时间序列数据重构为相空间流形，通过专利系统(US 63/949,330)提供隐私保护的"算法审计轨迹"。
AI.findings: 该协议能够将人力资本风险量化为客观、不可变的数字资产，使企业能够将员工福祉从定性描述转变为可审计的定量指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人力资本风险量化的新理论框架，将拓扑数据分析应用于人力资本评估，建立了从生理数据到可审计数字资产的转化范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可验证的人力资本审计工具，使人力资本从负债转变为资产，提升了ESG报告的可信度和审计价值。

title: Trading Privacy for Profit? The Influence of Social Media on E-Commerce and Privacy Rights in India
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Trading Privacy for Profit? The Influence of Social Media on E-Commerce and Privacy Rights in India
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the bisecting of social media, privacy rights and e-commerce, with an emphasis on methods through which these sites gather, examine and share the personal information with companies dealing with e-commerce. The algorithmic dependence of social media on continuous observation and prediction of user's action empower highly personalized market policies that fades the lines between convenience and misuse. Hence, customers are put through unwanted observation practices that scare their informational privacy. The paper gives various directions to stabilize the advantages of social media facilitated e-commerce with safeguarding privacy rights, outlining the investigation. These include strengthening illuminated consent measures, imposing data reduction methods, expanding clarity in algorithmic processing, and encouraging cross-border governing convergence. It also calls for significance corporate and consumer consciousness to allow customers to govern their digital trails in a better way. In the conclusion, while the merging of social media and e-commerce put forward exceptional anticipation for customers and businesses alike, it also gives rise to massive challenges to privacy rights and ethical standards. Addressing these challenges requires an overall approach that involves legislative reforms, technological innovation, and ethical sensitization in order to ensure that the digital economy matures with respect to and protection of individual privacy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究社交媒体、隐私权与电子商务的交集，分析社交媒体如何收集、分析和共享用户个人信息给电商公司，探讨算法依赖带来的隐私风险，并提出平衡电商便利与隐私保护的综合解决方案。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体与电子商务融合如何影响用户隐私权？如何平衡社交媒体促进的电子商务优势与隐私保护需求？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体与电子商务的深度融合创造了高度个性化的营销策略，但同时也模糊了便利与滥用的界限，导致用户面临不受欢迎的监控实践和信息隐私威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐私权理论、算法治理理论、数字消费者保护理论、数据伦理框架
AI.method: 概念性分析、政策分析、规范性研究（基于文献和现有实践的分析）
AI.findings: 社交媒体对用户行为的持续观察和预测算法赋能了高度个性化的营销，但侵蚀了隐私边界；当前实践缺乏充分的知情同意、数据最小化和算法透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社交媒体-电子商务-隐私权的交叉分析框架；发展了算法时代隐私保护的综合性理论视角；为数字治理提供了跨领域整合的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体解决方案：加强知情同意措施、实施数据最小化原则、提高算法处理透明度、促进跨境治理协调；呼吁提高企业和消费者意识；建议立法改革、技术创新和伦理教育的综合方法。

title: The Amadi Framework: Systems Analysis and Design at Its Fundamental Core

detail.title: The Amadi Framework: Systems Analysis and Design at Its Fundamental Core
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Amadi Framework, a constraint-first methodology that extends traditional systems thinking while drawing from the foundations of Systems Analysis and Design (SAND). Named after Amadioha, the Igbo deity of thunder and justice who enforces moral order, the framework operates on the principle that systems do not fail in the traditional sense but are limited by their design. The goal of this paper is to formalize a replicable methodology that enables practitioners to architect solutions for complex problems when traditional skill acquisition or ideal resources are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Amadi框架，这是一种约束优先的方法论，扩展了传统系统思维，同时借鉴了系统分析与设计的基础。该框架基于系统不会传统意义上失败而是受设计限制的原则，旨在为复杂问题提供可复制的解决方案架构方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种可复制的约束优先方法论，使从业者能够在传统技能获取或理想资源不可用时为复杂问题架构解决方案？
AI.motivation: 传统系统思维在资源受限或技能不足的情况下难以有效解决复杂问题，需要一种能够在这种约束条件下运作的方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统分析与设计（SAND）基础，约束优先方法论，系统思维扩展，以Amadioha（伊博族雷电与正义之神）为象征的道德秩序执行理念。
AI.method: Amadi框架作为约束优先的方法论，强调在资源限制下设计系统，而非传统意义上的系统失败分析。
AI.findings: 该论文提出了一个正式化的可复制方法论，能够指导从业者在资源受限条件下为复杂问题设计解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了系统思维理论，引入了约束优先的设计理念，将文化象征（Amadioha）融入方法论框架，丰富了系统分析与设计的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了在技能和资源受限情况下解决复杂问题的实用工具和方法论，提高了在非理想条件下的问题解决能力。

title: The GAB/BAG Integrated Model: A Dual-Layer Conceptual Framework for Operational Risk Mitigation in Private Banking

detail.title: The GAB/BAG Integrated Model: A Dual-Layer Conceptual Framework for Operational Risk Mitigation in Private Banking

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, or organizational conflicts of interest associated with this work. This research was conducted independently and has not been funded, supported, or influenced by any external organization or employer.
declarations.ethicsApproval: As this research is conceptual and does not involve human subjects, patient data, or sensitive personal information, no ethics approval was necessary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
The Swiss private banking sector is undergoing profound operational transformation driven by automation, digitalization, and increasing regulatory complexity. Traditional workflows remain heavily dependent on manual processes and are therefore exposed to delays, errors, and operational risks. At the same time, emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and blockchain provide new opportunities to strengthen and streamline core operational tasks.

This conceptual paper introduces the GAB/BAG Integrated Model, a dual-layer framework combining Generative AI for Banking (GAB) with Blockchain for Assurance & Governance (BAG). The model enhances operational efficiency, auditability, compliance, and decision support while addressing well-known limitations of AI-only systems.

This working paper establishes the theoretical foundation for future doctoral research on the empirical validation of the model through expert interviews, operational data analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GAB/BAG集成模型，这是一个结合生成式AI银行应用（GAB）和区块链保证与治理（BAG）的双层框架，旨在解决瑞士私人银行部门在自动化、数字化和监管复杂性背景下的运营挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合生成式AI和区块链技术来提升瑞士私人银行部门的运营效率、可审计性、合规性和决策支持？
AI.motivation: 瑞士私人银行部门正经历深刻的运营转型，传统工作流程依赖手动流程，存在延迟、错误和操作风险，而AI、机器学习和区块链等新兴技术为加强和简化核心运营任务提供了新机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: GAB/BAG集成模型（双层框架）：生成式AI银行应用（GAB）层和区块链保证与治理（BAG）层，旨在解决纯AI系统的已知局限性。
AI.method: 概念性论文，为未来博士研究建立理论基础，计划通过专家访谈和运营数据分析进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 该模型能够增强运营效率、可审计性、合规性和决策支持，同时解决纯AI系统的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了GAB/BAG集成模型这一创新理论框架，为金融科技领域的技术融合研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为瑞士私人银行部门提供了具体的运营转型解决方案，帮助银行应对自动化、数字化和监管复杂性的挑战，提升整体运营效能。
